a: Peloni ufeloni haddayyaynin shebbemakom peloni".
Verav sheshet – attu tanna ki rochla lichshoyv velezil?!

Amar rav nachman: mena amena la? ditnan: haddayyaynim chotmin lematta, o haedim. may, lav dayyaynim duvmya deedim – ma edim shenayim, af dayyaynim name shenayim? verav sheshet – midde irya?! ha kidita, veha kidita.
Lema li lemitne dayyaynim, lema li lemitne edim? ha ka mashma lan, dela shena katuv bilshon dayyaynim vechatmi edim, vela shena katuv bilshon edim vechatmi dayyaynim.
Mippene tikkun haolam: may "mippene tikkun haolam"? rabbi yochanan amar: mippene takkanat mamzerim. resh lakish amar: mippene takkanat agunot.
Rabbi yochanan amar mippene takkanat mamzerim – savar la kerav nachman, deamar bifne shenayim; uve tere let lehu kala; vehi la shama vela yada veazla uminnasva, veikka mamzerim.
Veresh lakish amar mippene takkanat agunot – savar la kerav sheshet, deamar bifne shelosha; uve telata it lehu kala; veshama veyada vela minnasva; vetakkanat agunot hu deikka.
Tanu rabbanan: bittelo – mevuttal, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: eno yachol lo levattelo velo lehosif al tenao, sheim ken, ma koach bet din yafe?
Umi ikka midde demiddeorayyta batel gitta, umishshum "ma koach bet din yafe", sharenan eshet ish lealma? in, kol dimkaddesh – addata derabbanan mekaddesh, veafkeinhu rabbanan lekiddushin minneh.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: tinach dekaddesh bechaspa, kaddesh bevia may ikka lememar? shavveyuha rabbanan livilato beilat zenut.
Tanu rabbanan, amar laasara: "kitvu get leishti", yachol levattel ze shello bifne ze, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: eno yachol levattel ella ze bifne ze.
Bemay kamippalgi? beedut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah kamippalgi; rabbi savar: edut shebbatla miktzatah
b: Lo batla kullah; vei azli hanach katvi veyahavi – lichtevu velittevu;
Rabban shimon ben gamliel savar: edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah; vehanach la yadi, veazli vechatvi veyahavi; vesharu eshet ish lealma.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma edut shebbatla miktzatah lo batla kullah; vehacha, hayeynu tama derabban shimon ben gamliel – kasavar: milleta demitavda beappe asra – tzericha be asra lemishlefa.
Ibbaya lehu: "kullechem", mahu? tama derabban shimon ben gamliel mishshum dekasavar: edut shebbatla miktzatah batla kullah – vehane, kevan daamar lehu "kullechem", la matzu katvi veyahavi;
O dilma, tama derabban shimon ben gamliel, mishshum dekasavar: kol milleta demitavda beappe be asra, tzericha be asra lemishlefa – vehilkach, afillu "kullechem" name?

Ta shema, amar lishnayim: "tenu get leishti", yachol levattel ze shello bifne ze, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: eno yachol levattel ella ze bifne ze. veha shenayim, dechi "chullechem" damu, ufeligi!
Amar rav ashe: i beede chetiva – hachi name; hacha bemay askinan, beede holacha.

Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: amar laze bifne atzmo velaze bifne atzmo – yachol levattel ze shello bifne ze. i amrat bishlama beede holacha – shappir; ella i amrat beede chetiva, mi mitztarfi?! ha amar mar: en edutan mitztarefet, ad sheyyiru shenehem keechad! dilma kerabbi yehoshua ben karcha sevira leh.
Amar rav shemuel bar yehuda: shemait minneh derabbi abba tarte – chada kerabbi, vachada kerabban shimon ben gamliel; vela yadana he kerabbi vehe kerabban shimon ben gamliel.

Amar rav yosef: nichze anan – dechi ata rav dimi, amar: maase veasa rabbi kedivre chachamim. amar lefanav rabbi parta beno shel rabbi elazar ben parta ben beno shel rabbi parta haggadol: im ken, ma koach bet din yafe? vechazar rabbi veasa kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Umiddeha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, hach kerabbi.

Veaf rabbi yoshiyya demin usha savar, chada kerabbi vachada kerabban shimon ben gamliel. deamar rabba bar bar chana: chamsha save havenan kammeh derabbi yoshiyya demin usha, ata hahu gavra kammeh, veashkeleh gitta al kurecheh. amar lan: zilu ittammuru uchetuvu la.
Vei salka datach kerabbi, ki mittammeri may have? ella shema minna kerabban shimon ben gamliel sevira leh;
Vei salka datach iddach name kerabban shimon ben gamliel, lema lehu ittammore? libbadderu ibbaddore! ella shema minna – chada kerabbi, vachada kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Verava amar rav nachman: halacha kerabbi bishtehen. velet leh lerav nachman "ma koach bet din yafe"?! vehaamar rav nachman, amar shemuel:

a: Yetomin shebbau lachalok benichse avihen, bet din maamidin lahen appotroppos, uvorrim lahen chelek yafe. higdilu – yecholin lemachot. verav nachman dideh amar: higdilu – en yecholin lemachot; deim ken, ma koach bet din yafe?
Hatam mamona, hacha issura.

Giddul bar reilay shaddar la gitta lidvethu; azal shelicha, ashkecha dahava yatva venavvla, amar la: he gittich. amara leh: zil hasheta miha, veta limchar. azal legabbeh vaamar leh. petach vaamar: "baruch hattov vehammetiv".
Abbaye amar: "baruch hattov vehammetiv", vela batel gitta. rava amar: "baruch hattov vehammetiv", uvatel gitta.
Bemay kamippalgi? begilluy data begitta kamippalgi – deabbaye savar: gilluy data begitta lav milleta hi, verava savar: gilluy data begitta milleta hi.
Amar rava: mena amena la? derav sheshet ashkeleh gitta lehahu gavra beal kurcheh, vaamar lehu lesahadi: hachi amar lechu rav sheshet – levattel gitta. veatzrecheh rav sheshet gitta acharina.
Veabbaye – attu rav sheshet mevattel gitta deinashe hava?! ihu battela; vehay dekaamar lehu hachi, mishshum dafnoye[10].

Veamar abbaye: mena amena la? derav yehuda ashkeleh gitta lechatneh derabbi yirmeya biraa, uvatteleh; tena ashkeleh, uvatteleh; hadar tena veashkeleh al kurcheh, vaamar lehu lesahadi: otivu kare beunnaychu uchetuvu leh. vei salka datach gilluy data begitta milleta hi, ha chazu leh deka rahet batrayyhu!
Verava – hay deka rahet batrayyhu, deamar lehu: ashshur havu la hayyay, ki hecha demishlam tzaara dehahu gavra.
Veamar abbaye: mena amena la? dehahu daamar lehu: i la atena ad telatin yomin, leheve gitta. ata, ufaskeh mabbara; amar lehu: "chazo daatay, chazo daatay"; vaamar shemuel: la shemeh matya.
Verava – attu hatam levattole gitta bae?! hatam lekayyome tenaeh ka vae, veha la ikkayyaym tenaeh.
Hahu daamar lehu: i la nasevna ad telatin yomin – leheve gitta. ki meto telatin yomin, amar lehu: ha tarachna.
Lemay nechush la? i mishshum unesa – en ones begittin. i mishshum galloye data begitta – pelugeta deabbaye verava hu.

Hahu daamar lehu: i la nasevna leresh yarcha daadar, leheve gitta. ki meta resh yarcha daadar, amar lehu: ana leresh yarcha denisan amari. lemay nechush la? i mishshum ones – en ones begittin. i mishshum galloye data – pelugeta deabbaye verava.
Vehilcheta kenachman; vehilcheta kenachman;
b: Vehilcheta kenachmani.

Mishna barishona haya meshanne shemo ushemah, shem iro veshem irah. hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken sheyyehe kotev: "ish peloni vechol shum sheyyesh lo", "ishsha pelonit vechol shum sheyyesh lah" – mippene tikkun haolam.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, shelachu leh bene medinat hayyam lerabban gamliel: bene adam habbaim mishsham lechan, shemo yosef – vekorin lo yochanan; yochanan – vekorin lo yosef, heach megarshin neshotehen? amad rabban gamliel, vehitkin sheyyehu kotvin: "ish peloni vechol shum sheyyesh lo", "ishsha pelonit vechol shum sheyyesh lah" – mippene tikkun haolam. amar rav ashe: vehu deittachzak bitre sheme. amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe: rabbi mari verabbi elazar kayymi kevotach.

Tanya kevoteh derav ashe: hayu lo shete nashim – achat bihuda veachat baggalil; velo shene shemot – echad bihuda veechad baggalil; vegerash et ishto shebbihuda bishmo shebbihuda, veet ishto shebbaggalil bishmo shebbaggalil – enah megoreshet, ad sheyyegaresh et ishto shebbihuda bishmo shebbihuda – veshem degalil immo; veet ishto shebbaggalil bishmo shebbaggalil – veshem dihuda immo. yatza lemakom acher, vegerash beechad mehen – megoreshet.
Vehaamrat shem degalil immo! ella shema minna – ha deittachzak, ha dela ettachzak; shema minna.
Hahi dahavo karu la miryam, ufureta sara. amri nehardae: miryam vechol shum sheyyesh lah, vela sara vechol shum sheyyesh lah.
Mishna en almana nifraat minnichse yetomim, ella bishvua. nimneu millehashbiah; hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken, shettehe noderet layyetomim kol ma sheyyirtzu, vegova ketubbatah.
Haedim chotmin al hagget, mippene tikkun haolam. vehillel hitkin perozbul, mippene tikkun haolam.
Gemara may irya almana, afillu kulle alma name; deha kayyma lan – habba lippara minnichse yetomin, lo yippara ella bishvua! almana itztericha leh, salka datach amena:

a: Mishshum chinna akkilu rabbanan gabba, ka mashma lan.

Nimneu millehashbiah: may tama? illema mishshum derav kahana – deamar rav kahana; veamri la amar rav yehuda, amar rav: maase beadam echad bishne vatztzoret, shehifkid dinar zahav etzel almana; vehinnichattu bechad shel kemach, vaafaattu befat, unetanattu leani;

Leyamim ba baal haddinar, vaamar la: havi li dinari. amra leh: yehanne sam hammavet beechad mibbaneha shel otah ishsha, im neheneti middinarcha kelum! amru: lo hayu yamim muatin ad shemmet echad mibbaneha; uchesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, amru: ma mi shennishba beemet – kach, hannishba al sheker – al achat kamma vechamma.
May tama ianasha? deishtarash la mekom dinar.
Umay "mi shennishba beemet"? kemi shennishba beemet.
I mishshum ha, may irya almana? afillu gerusha name! allema amar rabbi zera, amar shemuel: lo shanu ella almana, aval gerusha mashbiin otah?
Almana shane; divhahi hanaa deka tarcha kamme deyatme, atya leoroye hettera.
Amar rav yehuda, amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu, lo shanu ella bevet din, aval chutz levet din – mashbiin otah. ini?! veha rav la magbe ketubba learmalta! kashya.
Besura matnu hachi. binhardea matnu hachi – amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo shanu ella bevet din, aval chutz levet din – mashbiin otah. verav amar: afillu chutz levet din name en mashbiin otah.
Rav letameh – derav la magbe ketubba learmalta. veliaddera velaygbeyay! bishne derav kili nidre.

Hahi daatay lekammeh derav huna, amar la: ma eeved lich, derav la magbe ketubba learmalta. amara leh: midde hu tama – ella dilma naketna midde mikketubbati, chay Adonai tzevaot im neheneti mikketubbati kelum! amar rav huna: mode rav bekofetzet.
Hahi daatay lekammeh derabba bar rav huna, amar la: may eeved lich, derav la magbe ketubba learmalta, veabba mari la magbe ketubba learmalta.
Amara leh: hav li mezone. amar la: mezone name let lich; deamar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: hattovaat ketubbatah bevet din – en lah mezonot.
Amara leh: afchu lechuresye, keve tere avdat li! hafechu lechuresye vetartzu, vaafillu hachi la ipperak mechulesha.
Amar leh rav yehuda lerav yirmeya biraa: addera bevet din, veashbea chutz levet din, velete kala velippol beudeni, devaena ki hechi deeeved bah maase.
Gufa – amar rabbi zera amar shemuel: lo shanu ella almana, aval gerusha – mashbiin otah.

Ugerusha deaddera la?! veha shelachu mittam: "ech pelonita bat peloni kabbilat gitta min yeda deacha bar hidya demitkere "ayya mari"; unedarat vaasarat perot shebbaolam ala dela kabbilat mikketubbeta ella gelufekra echad, vesefer tehillim echad, vesefer iyyov, umimshalot beloim;
b: Veshamnum bachamishsha mane; lichshettavo leyedchem hagebuha et hashshear". amar rav ashe: hahu, get yevamin hava.
Hitkin rabban gamliel hazzaken shettehe noderet kulei: amar rav huna, lo shanu ella beshello nisset, aval nisset – en maddirin otah.
Nisset may tama – demefar la baal; ki lo nisset name, lechi minnasva mefar la baal! en habbaal mefer bekodmin.
Venechush dilma azla legabbe chacham veshare la! kasavar tzarich lefaret et hanneder.
Rav nachman amar: afillu nisset. nisset, vadday mefar la baal! demadderinan la barabbim.
Metivi: nisset – gova ketubbatah im nadra. may, lav nadra hasheta? la, dindara meikkara.
Vehatanya: nisset – noderet vegova ketubbatah! tannae hi, deikka leman deamar: neder shehuddar barabbim – yesh lo hafara; veikka leman deamar: en lo hafara.
Ibbaya lehu: tzarich lefaret et hanneder, o eno tzarich? rav nachman amar: eno tzarich; rav pappa amar: tzarich.
Rav nachman amar eno tzarich – dei amrat tzarich, zimnin degayez leh ledibbureh, vechacham may deshama mefar.
Rav pappa amar tzarich – mishshum milleta deissura.
Tenan: hannose nashim baavera – pasul, ad sheyyiddor hanaa. vetane ala: noder veoved, yored umegaresh. vei amrat eno tzarich lefaret et hanneder, lechush dilma azel legabbe chacham veshare leh!

a: Demadderinan leh berabbim. hanicha leman deamar neder shehuddar berabbim – en lo hafara; ella leman deamar yesh lo hafara, may ikka lememar?
Demadderinan leh al daat rabbim – deamar ammemar, hilcheta: afillu leman deamar neder shehuddar berabbim yesh lo hafara, al daat rabbim – en lo hafara.
Vehane mille lidvar harshut, aval lidvar mitzva – yesh lo hafara. ki hahu makre dardeke deaddereh rav acha al daat rabbim, dahava pasha beyanoke; veahdereh ravina, dela ishtechach dedayek kevoteh.
Vehaedim chotmin al hagget mippene tikkun haolam: mippene tikkun haolam?! deorayyta hu, dichtiv: "vechatov bassefer vechatom"!
Amar rabba: la tzericha – lerabbi elazar, deamar: ede mesira karti; takkinu rabbanan ede chatima, mippene tikkun haolam – dezimnin demayyti sahadi, i name zimnin deazli limdinat hayyam.
Rav yosef amar: afillu tema lerabbi meir, hitkinu sheyyehe edim mefarshin shemotehen begittin – mippene tikkun haolam.
Kidtanya: barishona haya kotev "ani peloni chatamti ed"; im ketav yado yotze mimmakom acher – kasher, veim lav – pasul.
Amar rabban gamliel: takkana gedola hitkinu, sheyyihyu mefarshin shemotehen begittin – mippene tikkun haolam.
Uvesimana la?! veha rav tzayer kevara; verabbi chanina tzayer charuta; rav chisda samech; verav hoshaya ayin; rabba bar rav huna tzayer machuta! shane rabbanan, divkiin simanayyhu.
Meikkara bemay afkeinhu? bediske.

Hillel hitkin perosbul vechulei: tenan hatam, perosbul eno meshammet. ze echad min haddevarim shehitkin hillel hazzaken; sheraa et haam shennimneu millehalvot ze et ze, veavru al ma shekkatuv battora "hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha veliyyaal vegomer", amad vehitkin perosbul.

Veze hu gufo shel perosbul: "mosrani lachem peloni [ufeloni] dayyaynin shebbemakom peloni, shekkol chov sheyyesh li etzel peloni, sheegbennu kol zeman sheertze". vehaddayyaynim chotmim lematta, o haedim.
Umi ikka midde demiddeorayyta meshammeta sheviit, vehitkin hillel dela meshammeta?! amar abbaye: bashsheviit bizman hazze, verabbi hi –

Detanya, rabbi omer: "veze devar hashshemitta shamot" – bishte shemitot hakkatuv medabber: achat shemittat karka veachat shemittat kesafim. bizman sheatta meshammet karka – atta meshammet kesafim, bizman shei atta meshammet karka, i atta meshammet kesafim.
b: Vetakkinu rabbanan ditshammet, zecher lashsheviit; raa hillel shennimneu haam millehalvot ze et ze, amad vehitkin perosbul.
Umi ikka midde demiddeorayyta la meshammeta sheviit, vetakkinu rabbanan ditshammet?!

Amar abbaye: shev veal taase hu. rava amar: hefker bet din – hefker. deamar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin shehefker bet din – hefker? shenneemar: "vechol asher lo yavo lishloshet hayyamim kaatzat hassarim vehazzekenim, yochoram kol rechusho vehu yibbadel mikkehal haggola".

Rabbi eliezer amar, mehacha: "elle hannechalot asher nichalu elazar hakkohen vihoshua bin nun verashe haavot vegomer". vechi ma inyan rashim etzel avot? lomar lach: ma avot manchilin et benehem kol ma sheyyirtzu, af rashim manchilin haam kol ma sheyyirtzu.
Ibbaya lehu: ki hitkin hillel perosbul – ledareh hu detakken, o dilma ledare alma name takken?

Lemay nafka minna? levattoleh. i amrat ledareh hu detakken – mevattelinan leh; ella i amrat ledare alma name takken, ha en bet din yachol levattel divre bet din chavero, ella im ken gadol hemennu bechochma uveminyan. may?
Ta shema, deamar shemuel: la katvinan perosbul ella i beve dina desura i beve dina dinhardea. vei salka datach ledare alma name takken, bishar be dina name lichtevu!
Dilma ki takken hillel ledare alma – kegon be dina dideh, ucherav amme verav assi, deallime leafkoe mamona; aval lechulle alma – la.

Ta shema, deamar shemuel: ha perosbula – ulebana dedayyayne hu; i ayayshshar chayil avattelinneh. avattelinneh?! veha en bet din yachol levattel divre bet din chavero, ella im ken gadol hemennu bechachma uveminyan! hachi kaamar: im ayayshsher chayil yoter mehillel, avattelinneh.
Verav nachman amar: akayyeyminne. akayyeyminne?! ha mikkayyaym vekae! hachi kaamar: ema beh milleta, deaf al gav delo katuv kechatuv dame.
Ibbaya lehu: hay ulebana – lishshana dechutzepa hu, o lishshana denichuta hu? ta shema, deamar ulla: aluva kalla shezzinneta bekerev chuppatah.
Amar rav mari bera devat shemuel: may kera? "ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi natan recho". amar rava: adayin chabbivuta hu gabban, dichtiv "natan", vela ketiv "hisriach".
Tanu rabbanan: hanneelavin veenan olvim, shomin cherpatan veen meshivin, osin meahava usemechin beyissurin, alehen hakkatuv omer: "veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato".
May "perosbul"? amar rav chisda: peros bule uvute.

a: Bule – ellu ashirim, dichtiv: "veshavarti et geon uzzechem", vetane rav yosef: ellu bulaot shebbihuda. bute – ellu haaniyyim, dichtiv: "haavet taavitennu". amar leh rava lelaoza: may perosbul? amar leh: puresa demilleta.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: yetomin, en tzerichin perosbul. vechen tane rame bar chama: yetomin en tzerichin perosbul, derabban gamliel uvet dino avihen shel yetomin.

Tenan hatam: en kotvin perosbul ella al hakkarka. im en lo – mezakkehu betoch sadehu kol shehu. vechamma kol shehu? amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: afillu kelach shel keruv. amar rav yehuda: afillu hishilo makom letannur ulechirayim – kotvin alav perosbul.
Ini?! vehatane hillel: en kotvin perosbul ella al atzitz nakuv bilvad. nakuv – in, sheeno nakuv – la;
Ammay? veha ikka mekomo! la tzericha, demannach assikke.

Rav ashe makne leh gidma dedikla, uchetav aleh perosbul. rabbanan deve rav ashe masri millayyhu lahadade. rabbi yonatan mesar mille lerabbi chiyyay bar abba; amar leh: tzerichna midde acharina? amar leh: la tzerichat.
Tanu rabbanan: en lo karka, velearev yesh lo karka – kotvin alav perosbul. lo velearev en lahen karka, velachayyayv lo yesh lo karka – kotvin alav perosbul, midderabbi natan –
Detanya, rabbi natan omer: minnayin lannoshe bachavero mane, vachavero bachavero, minnayin shemmotziin mizze venotnin laze? talmud lomar: "venatan laasher asham lo".

Tenan hatam: hashsheviit meshammetet et hammilva, ben bishtar ben shello bishtar. rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: bishtar – shetar sheyyesh bo achrayut nechasim, shello bishtar – sheen bo achrayut nechasim; kol shekken milve al pe.
Rabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish deamri tarvayyhu: bishtar – shetar sheen bo achrayut nechasim, shello bishtar – milve al pe. aval shetar sheyyesh bo achrayut nechasim – eno meshammet.

Tanya kevateh derabbi yochanan verabbi shimon ben lakish: shetar chov – meshammet, veim yesh bo achrayut nechasim – eno meshammet. tanya iddach: siyyem lo sade achat behalevoato, eno meshammet. velo od, ella afillu katav: "kol nechasayy achrain vearvain lach" – eno meshammet.

Kariveh derabbi assi hava leh hahu shetara dahava ketiv beh achrayut nechasim, ata lekammeh derabbi assi, amar leh: meshammet o eno meshammet? amar leh: eno meshammet. shavkeh, vaata lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: meshammet.

Ata rabbi assi lekammeh derabbi yochanan, amar leh: meshammet o eno meshammet? amar leh: meshammet. veha mar hu deamar eno meshammet! amar leh: vechi mippene sheanu medammin, naase maase?! amar leh: vehatanya kevoteh demar! amar leh: dilma hahi bet shammay hi, deamri: shetar haomed ligbot – kegavuy dame.
Tenan hatam: hammalve et chavero maot al hammashkon, vehammoser shetarotav levet din – en meshammetin. bishlama moser shetarotav levet din – detafsi lehu be dina. ella malve al hammashkon, may tama?
Amar rava: mishshum detafes leh. amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, hilvahu vedar bachatzero – detafes leh, hachi name dela meshammet?!

Amar leh: shane mashkon, dekane leh midderabbi yitzchak – deamar rabbi yitzchak: minnayin levaal chov shekkone mashkon? shenneemar: "ulecha tihye tzedaka" – im eno kone, tzedaka minnayin? mikkan levaal chov shekkone mashkon.
Tenan hatam:
b: Hammachazir chov lachavero bashsheviit – tzarich sheyyomar lo: "meshammet ani"; veim amar lo: "af al pi chen", yekabbel hemennu. shenneemar: "veze devar hashshemitta".

Amar rabba: vetale leh ad deamar hachi. etiveh abbaye: keshehu noten lo, al yomar lo: "bechovi ani noten lach", ella yomar lo: "shelli hen, uvemattana ani noten lach"! amar leh: tale leh name ad deamar hachi.

Abba bar marta, dehu abba bar minyome, hava massek beh rabba zuze. ayytinhu nihaleh bishviit, amar leh: meshammet ani. shaklinhu vaazal. ata abbaye, ashkecheh dahava atziv, amar leh: ammay atziv mar? amar leh: hachi hava maase.

Azal legabbeh, amar leh: amtet leh zuze lemar? amar leh: in. amar leh: umay amar lach? amar leh: "meshammet ani". amar leh: vaamart leh "af al pi chen"? amar leh: la. amar leh: vei amart leh "af al pi chen", hava shaklinhu minnach; hasheta mihat amtinhu nihaleh, veema leh "af al pi chen". azal amtinhu nihaleh, vaamar leh "af al pi chen". shaklinhu minneh, amar: la hava beh data behay tzureba merabbanan meikkara.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav nachman: neeman adam lomar: "perosbul haya beyadi, veavad mimmenni". may tama? kevan detakkinu rabbanan perosbul, la shavek hettera veachel issura.
Ki ato lekammeh derav, amar leh: midde perosbul haya lecha veavad? kegon ze, "petach picha laillem" hu.
Tenan: vechen baal chov shemmotzi shetar chov, veen immo perosbul – hare ellu lo yipparu.
Tannae hi – detanya: hammotzi shetar chov – tzarich sheyyehe immo perosbul. vachachamim omrim: eno tzarich.
Mishna eved shennishba ufedauhu, im leshum eved – yishtabed; im leshum ben chorin – lo yishtabed. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ben kach uven kach yishtabed.
Gemara bemay askinan? ilema lifne yeush, leshum ben chorin – ammay la yishtabed? ella leachar yeush, leshum eved – ammay yishtabed?

Amar abbaye: leolam lifne yeush, uleshum eved – yishtabed lerabbo rishon, leshum ben chorin – lo yishtabed lo lerabbo rishon velo lerabbo sheni; lerabbo sheni la, deha leshum ben chorin parkeh, lerabbo rishon name la, dilma mimmani vela parki.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ben kach uven kach yishtabed – kasavar: keshem shemmitzva lifdot et bene chorin, kach mitzva lifdot et haavadim.

Rava amar: leolam leachar yeush, uleshum eved – yishtabed lerabbo sheni, leshum ben chorin – lo yishtabed lo lerabbo rishon velo lerabbo sheni; lerabbo sheni la, deha leshum ben chorin parkeh, lerabbo rishon name la, deha leachar yeush hava.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ben kach uven kach yishtabed – kidchizkiyya, deamar chizkiyya: mippene ma amru ben kach uven kach yishtabed? shello yehe kol echad veechad holech umappil atzmo ligyaysot, umafkia atzmo miyyad rabbo.
Metivi, amar lahen rabban shimon ben gamliel: keshem shemmitzva lifdot et bene chorin, kach mitzva lifdot et haavadim. bishlama leabbaye – deamar lifne yeush, hayeynu dekaamar "keshem";
Ella lerava – deamar leachar yeush, hay "keshem"?! mishshum dechizkiyya hu!
Amar lach rava: rabban shimon ben gamliel la have yada may kaamri rabbanan, vehachi kaamar lehu: i lifne yeush kaamritu – hayeynu "keshem"; i leachar yeush kaamritu – kidchizkiyya.
Ulerava – deamar leachar yeush, ulerabbo sheni; rabbo sheni mimman kane leh – mishshabbay, shabbay gufeh mi kane leh?!
In; kane leh lemaase yadav – deamar resh lakish: minnayin legoy, shekkana et haggoy lemaase yadav? shenneemar: "vegam mibbene hattoshavim haggarim immachem mehem tiknu" – attem konim mehem,

a: Velo hem konim mikkem, velo hem konim ze mizze. yachol lo yiknu ze et ze? yachol lo yiknu ze et ze?! haamrat: lo hem konim ze mizze! hachi kaamar: velo hem konim ze mizze legufo.
Yachol lo yiknu ze et ze lemaase yadav? amarta kal vachomer: goy – yisrael, kone; goy – goy, lo kol shekken?!
Veema: hane mille bechaspa, aval bachazaka – la! amar rav pappa: ammon umoav taharu besichon.
Ashkechan goy – goy; goy – yisrael, menalan? dichtiv: "vayyishb mimmennu shevi".
Amar rav shemen bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: eved shebbarach mibbet haasurim – yatza lecherut, velo od ella shekkofin et rabbo vechotev lo get shichrur.

Tenan, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ben kach uven kach yishtabed; veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu – halacha kemoto, chutz mearev vetzaydan ureaya acharona.
Bishlama leabbaye, moke la lehay – lifne yeush, vehay – leachar yeush.
Ella lerava – deamar leachar yeush, kashya derabbi yochanan adderabbi yochanan!
Amar lach rava: tama may – mishshum dechizkiyya; boreach shane – hasheta liktala mesar nafsheh, appole appel nafsheh ligyaysot?!

Amteh demar shemuel ishtevay. parkuha leshum amhuta, veshadderuha leh. shelachu leh: anan – kerabban shimon ben gamliel sevira lan, at – i name kerabbanan sevira lach, anan leshum amhuta parkinan la (nihala).
Veinhu sevur – lifne yeush hava, vela hi – leachar yeush hava, ushemuel – la mibbaya deishtabode la mishtabad ba, ella gitta decheruta name la atzrecha.

Shemuel letameh, deamar shemuel: hammafkir avdo – yatza lecherut, veeno tzarich get shichrur, shenneemar: "vechol eved ish miknat kasef" – "eved ish" velo "eved ishsha"?! ella eved sheyyesh lo reshut lerabbo alav – karuy eved; sheen lo reshut lerabbo alav – en karuy eved.
Amteh derabbi abba bar zutera ishtevay, parka hahu tarmodaa leshum itteta. shelachu leh ledideh: i yaut avdat, shaddar la gitta decheruta.
Hechi dame? i dematzu parki la, lema li gitta decheruta? i dela matzu parki la, ki shaddar la gitta decheruta may have?

Leolam dematzu parki la; vechevan dimshaddar lah gitta decheruta, chabbore michabberi ahadade, ufarki la. veibbaet ema: leolam dela matzu parki la, vechevan dimshaddar la gitta decheruta, mittazla beappeh, umefarek la.
Vehaamar mar: chaviva lahen behemtan shel yisrael yoter minneshotehen! hane mille betzina, aval befarhesya zila behu milleta.

Hahi amta dahavat befumebdita, dahavo ka meabbedi ba inashe issura. amar abbaye, i lav deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hameshachrer avdo over baase; hava kayefna leh lemara, vechatev la gitta decheruta. ravina amar: ki ha mode rav yehuda, mishshum milleta deissura.
Veabbaye – mishshum issura la?! haamar rav chanina bar rav kattina amar rabbi yitzchak: maase beishsha achat shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin,
b: Vechafu et rabbah vaasaah bat chorin, veamar rav nachman bar yitzchak: minhag hefker nahagu bah!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam la leeved chazya vela leven chorin chazya, hacha efshar dimyached la leavdeh, umenattar la.
Gufa – amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hameshachrer avdo over baase, shenneemar: "leolam bahem taavodu".
Metivi: maase berabbi eliezer shennichnas bevet hakkeneset velo matza asara, veshichrer avdo vehishlimo laasara! mitzva shane.
Tanu rabbanan: "leolam bahem taavodu" – reshut, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: chova. vedilma rabbi eliezer savar la keman deamar reshut!
La salka datach; detanya behedya, rabbi eliezer omer: chova.

Amar rabba: behane telat mille, nachati baale vattim minnichsehon: demappeki avdayyhu lecheruta, udesayyri nichsayyhu beshabbeta, udekavi seudetayyhu beshabbeta beiddan be midresha. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: shete mishpachot hayu birushalayim, achat kava seuddatah beshabbat veachat kava seuddatah beerev shabbat, ushetehen nekeru.
Amar rabba amar rav: hammakdish avdo, yatza lecherut. may tama? gufeh – la kaddish; lidme – la kaamar; delehve "am kadosh" kaamar.
Verav yosef amar rav: hammafkir avdo, yatza lecherut. man deamar makdish – kol shekken mafkir; man deamar mafkir – aval makdish la, dilma lidme kaamar.
Ibbaya lehu: tzarich get shichrur, o lo tzarich? ta shema, deamar rav chiyyay bar avin amar rav: echad ze veechad ze, yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur.

Amar rabba: umotvinan ashshematin – hammakdish nechasav vehayu bahen avadim, en haggizbarin rashshain lehotzian lecherut; aval mochrin otan laacherim, vaacherim motziin otan lecherut. rabbi omer: omer ani, af hu – noten deme atzmo veyotze, mippene shehu kemochro lo! matnita ka ramet aleh derav?! rav tanna hu, ufaleg.
Ta shema: "ach kol cherem vegomer meadam" – ellu avadav veshifchotav hakkenaanim! hacha bemay askinan – deamar lidme.
I hachi, iddach name deamar lidme!
I hachi, "en haggizbarim rashshain lehotzian lecherut" – gizbarim may avidtayyhu?

Vetu – "aval mochrin otan laacherim, vaacherim motziin otan lecherut" – acherim may avidtayyhu? vetu – "rabbi omer: omer ani, af hu – noten deme atzmo veyotze, mippene shehu kemochro lo" – vei lidme, may "mippene shehu kemochro lo"?
Ta shema: hammakdish avdo – ose veochel, shello hikdish ella damav!

a: Ha manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar: en adam motzi devarav levattala.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: vechen hu, shehikdish atzmo – ose veochel, shello hikdish ella damav. i amrat bishlama rabbi meir hi – shappir;
Ella i amrat rabbanan hi, bishlama avdo – lidme kae, ella ihu – lidme kae?!
Lema ketannae – hammakdish avdo, en moalin bo. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: moalin bisaro. may, lav beha kamippalgi – demar savar: kadosh; umar savar: la kadosh?
Vetisbera?! hay "moalin bo" veen moalin bo"?! hay "kadosh" veeno kadosh" mibbee leh!
Ella dechulle alma kadosh, vehacha beha kamippalgi – demar savar: avda kimkarkee dame; umar savar: kemittalteli dame.
I hachi, addemippalgi bisaro, lippalgu begufo!
Ella dechulle alma avda kimkarkee dame, vehacha bisaro haomed liggazez kamippalgi – mar savar: kegazuz dame; umar savar: lav kegazuz dame.

Lema hane tannae – kehane tannae? ditnan, rabbi meir omer: yesh devarim shehem kakkarka veenan kakkarka, veen chachamim modim lo. ketzad? "eser gefanim teunot masarti lach", vehalla omer: "enan ella chamesh" – rabbi meir mechayyev; vachachamim omrim: kol hamechubbar lakkarka hare hu kakkarka.
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: anavim haomdot libbatzer ikka benayyhu; derabbi meir savar: kivtzurot damyayn; verabbanan savri: lav kivtzurot damyayn.
Afillu tema rabbi meir – ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir hatam, ella baanavim – dechamma dekayyman michchash kechishi; aval hacha – kamma dekae ashboche mashbach.

Ki selek rabbi chiyyay bar yosef, amar lehay shemata derav kammeh derabbi yochanan. amar leh: amar rav hachi? vehu – la amar hachi?! vehaamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur!

Hachi kaamar leh: amar rav kevoti? veikka deamri: la sayyeymuha kammeh, amar leh: vela amar rav tzarich get shichrur?! verabbi yochanan letameh – deamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: hammafkir avdo yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur.
Gufa – amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: hammafkir avdo – yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur.

Etiveh rabbi abba leulla: ger shemmet uvizbezu yisrael nechasav, vehayu bahen avadim – ben gedolim uven ketannim, kanu atzman bene chorin. abba shaul omer: gedolim – kanu atzman bene chorin; ketannim – kol hammachzik bahen, zacha bahen.
Vechi mi katav get shichrur leellu?
Amar: dame hay midderabbanan kidla gamri inashe shemata. vetama may? amar rav nachman, kasavar ulla: avdo deger ki ishto – ma ishto mishtallachat belo get, af avadav mishtallechim belo get.
I hachi, afillu yisrael name! amar kera: "vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem lareshet achuzza".
I hachi, hammafkir avdo vamet – name; allema amar ammemar: hammafkir avdo vamet – oto haeved en lo takkana? deammemar kashya.
Amar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha keabba shaul. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi yaakov bar idi:
b: Beferush shemia lach, o mikkelala shemia lach? may kelala? deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, amru lifne rabbi: amar "nityayashti mippeloni avdi", mahu? amar lahem: omer ani, en lo takkana ella bishtar.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi? gamar "lah"–"lah" meishsha – ma ishsha bishtar, af eved name bishtar.
Veka dayykat minna, keishsha – ma ishsha issura vela mamona, af eved name issura vela mamona.
Vei mikkelala may? amar leh: adderabba! dok minna leiddach gisa: ma ishsha – ben gedola ben ketanna, af eved name – ben gadol ben katan! amar leh: beferush shemia li.

Verabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: en halacha keabba shaul. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi chiyyay bar abba: beferush shemia lach, o mikkelala shemia lach? may kelala? deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, amru lifne rabbi: "nityayashti mippeloni avdi", mahu? amar lahem: omer ani, en lo takkana ella bishtar.
Veamar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi? gamar "lah"–"lah" meishsha – ma ishsha bishtar, af eved name bishtar.
Veka dayykat minna, keishsha – ma ishsha ben gedola ben ketanna, af eved name ben gadol ben katan.
Vei mikkelala may? adderabba! dok minna lehach gisa: ma ishsha – issura vela mamona, af eved name – issura vela mamona! amar leh: beferush shemia li.
Amar mar, amar lahem: omer ani, en lo takkana ella bishtar. vehatanya, rabbi omer: omer ani, af hu – noten deme atzmo veyotze, mippene shehu kemochro lo!
Hachi kaamar: o bechesef o bishtar; vehay – peka leh kaspeh. uleappoke mehay tanna –
Detanya, rabbi shimon omer mishshum rabbi akiva: yachol yehe kesef gomer bah, kederech sheshshetar gomer bah? talmud lomar: "vehofde lo nifdata" –
Ora kol happarasha kuvllah lelo chuppasha", lomar lach: shetar gomer bah, veen hakkesef gomer bah.
Amar rame bar chama amar rav nachman: halacha kerabbi shimon. verav yosef bar chama amar rabbi yochanan: en halacha kerabbi shimon.

Ashkecheh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava bar sheelta, dahava kae appitcha deve tefilla. amar leh: halacha o en halacha? amar leh: ani omer – en halacha; verabbanan daato mimmachoza amri, amar rabbi zera mishshemeh derav nachman: halacha;

Vechi atay lesura, ashkachteh lerabbi chiyyay bar avin, amri leh: ema li izi, gufa deovada hechi hava? amar li: dehahi amta dahava mara shechiv mera, atya bachya kammeh, amra leh: ad emat tishtabed vetezil hahi itteta? shekal kumeteh sheda ba, amar la: zil keni ha ukeni nafshich. ato lekammeh derav nachman, amar lehu: lo asa velo chelum.
Man dachaza, savar mishshum dahalacha kerabbi shimon; vela hi, ella mishshum dehave leh kelav shel makne.
Amar rav shemuel bar achitay, amar rav hamenuna sava, amar rabbi yitzchak bar ashyan, amar rav huna, amar rav hamenuna: halacha kerabbi shimon. vela hi, en halacha kerabbi shimon.
Amar rabbi zera, amar rabbi chanina, amar rav ashe, amar rabbi: eved shennasa et bat chorin bifne rabbo –

a: Yatza lecherut. amar lo rabbi yochanan: kol kach yesh beyadcha?! vaani shone: hakkotev shetar erusin leshifchato, rabbi meir omer: mekuddeshet, vachachamim omrim: enah mekuddeshet!
Kidamar rabba bar rav shela – kesherabbo hinniach lo tefillin; hacha name – kesherabbo hissio ishsha.
Umi ikka midde dilavdeh – la miavad leh issura, veihu – aved issura?!

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hacha bemay askinan – deamar lah: "tzei bo vehitkaddeshi bo"; rabbi meir savar: yesh ballashon hazze leshon shichrur, verabbanan savri: en ballashon hazze leshon shichrur.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: eved shehinniach tefillin bifne rabbo – yatza lecherut. metivi: lava hemennu rabbo, o sheasao rabbo appotroppos, o shehinniach tefillin bifne rabbo, o shekkara shelosha pesukim bevet hakkeneset bifne rabbo, hare ze lo yatza lecherut!
Amar rabba bar rav shela: kesherabbo hinniach lo tefillin.

Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan: mi sheamar bishat mitato "pelonit shifchati al yishtabedu bah leachar moti" – kofin et hayyorshim vechotvin lah get shichrur. amru lefanav rabbi amme verabbi assi: rabbi, i atta mode shebbaneha avadim?

Ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar rabbi yochanan: mi sheamar bishat mitato "pelonit shifchati korat ruach asta li; yease lah korat ruach" – kofin et hayyorshin veosin lah korat ruach. may tama? mitzva lekayyem divre hammet.
Amar ammemar: hammafkir avdo – oto eved en lo takkana. may tama? gufeh la kane leh – issura hu deikka gabbeh, veissura la matze makne leh.
Amar leh rav ashe leammemar: vehaamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan, verav chiyyay bar avin amar rav: echad ze veechad ze yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur! amar leh: "tzarich" – veen lo takkana.

Ikka deamri, amar ammemar: hammafkir avdo vamet – oto haeved en lo takkana. may tama? gufeh la kane leh – issura hu deikka gabbeh, veissura livreh la moret. amar leh rav ashe leammemar: veha ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yochanan!
Derav dimi tauta hi. amar leh: may tauta – dela amra bilshon shichrur; ha amra bilshon shichrur – hachi name! amar leh: ana kidrav shemuel bar yehuda sevira li.

Hahu diskarta deavde deizdabban legoy. kelo marvota batrae, ato lekammeh deravina, amar lehu: zilu ahdaru abbene marvota kammae, veyichtevu lechu gitta decheruta. amaru leh rabbanan leravina, vehaamar ammemar: hammafkir avdo vamet – oto haeved en lo takkana!
Amar lehu: ana kerav dimi sevira li. amaru leh: derav dimi tauta hi! amar lehu: may tauta – dela amra bilshon shichrur; ha amra bilshon shichrur – hachi name! vehilcheta keravina.
Hahu avda deve tere, kam chad minnayyhu veshachrereh lefalgeh, amar iddach: hasheta shami bi rabbanan umafsedu leh minnay; azal akneyeh livno katan.
Shalcha rav yosef bereh derava lekammeh derav pappa, shelach leh: "kaasher asa ken yease lo, gemulo yashiv lo berosho" – anan kim lan beyanoka dimkarva dateh legabbe zuze; mokminan leh appotroppos,
b: Umekarkesh leh zuze, vechatev leh gitta decheruta al shemeh.
Tanu rabbanan, haomer: "asiti peloni avdi ben chorin"; "asuy ben chorin"; "hare hu ben chorin" – hare hu ben chorin.
"Eesennu ben chorin" – rabbi omer: kana, vachachamim omrim: lo kana. amar rabbi yochanan: vechullan – bishtar.

Tanu rabbanan, haomer: "natatti sade pelonit lifloni"; "netuna lifloni"; "hare hi shello" – hare hi shello. "ettenenna lifloni" – rabbi meir omer: kana; vachachamim omrim: lo kana. amar rabbi yochanan: vechullan – bishtar.

Tanu rabbanan, haomer: "asiti peloni avdi ben chorin", vehu omer: "lo asaani" – chayyshinan shemma zikka lo al yede acher. "katavti venatatti lo", vehu omer: "lo katav li velo natan li" – hodaat baal din kemea edim dame.

Haomer: "natatti sade pelonit lifloni", vehu omer: "lo natan li" – chayyshinan shemma zikka lo al yede acher. "katavti venatatti lo", vehu omer: "lo katav velo natan li" – hodaat baal din kemea edim dame.
Mi ochel perot? rav chisda amar: noten ochel perot; verabba amar: meshalleshin et happerot.
Vela peligi: ha beabba, ha bivra.

Mishna eved sheasao rabbo appoteke laacherim, veshichrero – shurat haddin en haeved chayyayv kelum; ella mippene tikkun haolam, kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin, vechotev shetar al damav. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: eno kotev, ella meshachrer.
Gemara eved sheasao rabbo appoteke veshichrero: mi shichrero? amar rav: rabbo rishon. shurat haddin en haeved chayyayv kelum lerabbo sheni –
Kidrava, deamar rava: hekdesh, chametz veshichrur – mafkiin mide shibud; ella mippene tikkun haolam, shemma yimtzaennu bashshuk

a: Veyomar lo: "avdi atta" – kofin et rabbo sheni, veose oto ben chorin, vechotev eved shetar al damav. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en haeved kotev ella meshachrer kotev.
Bemay ka mippalgi? bemazzik shibudo shel chavero ka mippalgi – demar savar chayyayv, umar savar patur.
Ittemar name: hammazzik shibudo shel chavero, banu lemachloket rabban shimon ben gamliel verabbanan.

Ulla amar: mi shichrero – rabbo sheni. shurat haddin en haeved chayyayv kelum bemitzvot; ella mippene tikkun haolam – shehare yatza alav shem ben chorin, kofin et rabbo rishon veose oto ben chorin, vechotev shetar al damav. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: eno kotev, ella meshachrer kotev.
Bemay kamippalgi? behezzek sheeno nikkar kamippalgi – mar savar: shemeh hezzek, umar savar: la shemeh hezzek.
Ulla, may tama la amar kerav? amar lach: sheni – "rabbo" karet leh?!
Verav, may tama la amar keulla? amar lach: sheni – "meshachrer" karet leh?!
Ittemar: haosa sadehu appoteke laacherim, ushetafah nahar; amme shappir nae amar rabbi yochanan: eno gove mishshear nechasim; vaavu dishmuel amar: gove mishshear nechasim.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: mishshum deamme shappir nae hu, omer shemata dela shappiran?! tetargam shemateh, daamar leh: "lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizzo".
Tanya name hachi: haosa sadehu appoteke leacher, ushetafah nahar – gove mishshear nechasim. veim amar lo: "lo yehe lecha peraon ella mizzo" – eno gove mishshear nechasim.

Tanya iddach: haose sadehu appoteke levaal chov velichtubbat ishsha – govin mishshear nechasim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: baal chov gove mishshear nechasim, ishsha enah gova mishshear nechasim – sheen darkah shel ishsha lechazzer al batte dinin.

Mishna mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin – oved et rabbo yom echad, veet atzmo yom echad; divre bet hillel. bet shammay omrim: tikkantem et rabbo, veet atzmo lo tikkantem – lissa shifcha i efshar, shekkevar chetzyo ben chorin;
b: Bat chorin i efshar, shekkevar chetzyo eved. yibbatel? vahalo lo nivra haolam ella lifriyya ureviyya, shenneemar: "lo tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah"! ella mippene tikkun haolam – kofin et rabbo veose oto ben chorin, vechotev shetar al chatzi damav. vechazru bet hillel lehorot kedivre bet shammay.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: hameshachrer chatzi avdo, rabbi omer: kana, vachachamim omrim: lo kana.
Amar rabba: machloket bishtar – derabbi savar: "vehofde lo nifdata o chufesha lo nittan lah" –
Makkish shetar lechesef, ma kesef – ben kullo ben chetzyo, af shetar name – ben kullo ben chetzyo;
Verabbanan gamri "lah"–"lah" meishsha – ma ishsha chetzyah lo, af eved name chetzyo lo; aval bechesef – divre hakkol kana, peduya veenah peduya.
Lema beha kamippalgi – demar savar: hekkesha adif, umar savar: gezera shava adifa?
La; dechulle alma gezera shava adifa, veshane hacha deikka lemifrach: ma leishsha shekken enah yotza bechesef, tomar beeved sheyyotze bechesef.
Verav yosef amar: machloket bechesef – derabbi savar: "vehofde lo nifdata" – peduya veenah peduya; verabbanan savri: dibbera tora kilshon bene adam; aval bishtar – divre hakkol lo kana.
Metivi: hameshachrer chatzi avdo bishtar, rabbi omer: kana, vachachamim omrim: lo kana. teyuveta derav yosef! teyuveta.
(Nema) bishtar hu difligi, aval bechesef la peligi; lema tehve teyuveta derav yosef betarte!
Amar lecha rav yosef: peligi bishtar, vehu haddin bechesef. veha deka mippalgi bishtar – lehodiacha kocho derabbi.
Velifleguy bechesef, ulehodiacha kochan derabbanan! koach dehettera adif leh.
Ta shema: "vehofde"; yachol lakkol? talmud lomar: "lo nifdata". i "lo nifdata", yachol lakkol? talmud lomar: "vehofde". ha ketzad? peduya veenah peduya; bechesef uveshave kesef.
Veen li ella bechesef, bishtar minnayin? talmud lomar: "vehofde lo nifdata o chufesha lo nittan lah", ulehallan hu omer: "vechatav lah sefer keritut" – ma lehallan bishtar, af kan bishtar.

En li ella chetzyo bechesef, o kullo bishtar; chetzyo bishtar minnayin? talmud lomar: "vehofde lo nifdata o chufesha lo nittan lah" – makkish shetar lechesef, ma kesef ben kullo ben chetzyo, af shetar name ben kullo ben chetzyo.
Bishlama lerav yosef batar deittotav, ha manni – rabbi hi. ella lerabba – resha divre hakkol, vesefa rabbi?!
Amar lach rabba: in, resha divre hakkol, vesefa rabbi. rav ashe amar: rabbi hi.
Ella matnitin dekatane: mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin; bishlama lerabba – mokem la bechesef, vedivre hakkol; ella lerav yosef – lema rabbi hi vela rabbanan?! amar ravina:

a: Beeved shel shene shuttafin, vedivre hakkol.
Amar rabba: machaloket – besheshshichrer chetzyo vehinniach chetzyo; aval shichrer chetzyo, umachar chetzyo o natan bemattana chetzyo, kevan dekanafek minneh kulleh – divre hakkol kana.

Amar leh abbaye: uvechullo – la peligi?! vehatane chada: hakkotev nechasav lishne avadav – kanu umeshachrerin ze et ze. vetanya iddach, haomer: "kol nechasay netunin lifloni ufeloni avadayy" – af atzmam lo kanu.
May, lav ha rabbi, veha rabbanan?!
La, idi veidi rabbanan; ha deamar kullo, ha deamar chatzi chatzi.
Veha middekatane sefa: veim amar chatzi chatzi – lo kanu, mikkelal deresha deamar kullo! paroshe ka mefaresh – af atzman lo kanu, ketzad? kegon deamar chatzi chatzi.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach resha deamar kullo – hasheta amar kullo lo kanu, amar chatzi chatzi mibbaya?!

I mishshum ha la irya – tena sefa legalloye resha, shello tomar: resha deamar chatzi chatzi, aval amar kullo kanu; tena sefa deamar chatzi chatzi, mikkelal deresha deamar kullo – vaafillu hachi lo kanu.
Veibbaet ema, la kashya: kan bishtar echad, kan bishne shetarot.

Bishtar echad, may irya chatzi chatzi? afillu amar kullo name lo kanu! hachi name kaamar: af atzman lo kanu, bamme devarim amurim – bishtar echad, aval bishne shetarot – kanu; veim amar chatzi chatzi – af bishne shetarot name la kanu.
Veibbaet ema: la kashya – kan bevat achat, kan beze achar ze.
Bishlama batra la kane, deha kane leh kamma; ella kamma, likne nafsheh velikneyeh lechavreh! ella mechavvavrta kidshanninan meikkara.
Rav ashe amar: shane hatam, deka kare lehu "avadayy". amar leh rafram lerav ashe: vedilma "avadayy" – shehayu kevar!

Mi la tenan: hakkotev kol nechasav leavdo – yatza lecherut; shiyyer karka kol shehu – lo yatza lecherut. rabbi shimon omer: leolam hu ben chorin, ad sheyyomar: "kol nechasay netunin lifloni avdi, chutz meechad meribbo shebbahen".
Tama deamar ["chutz meechad meribbo shebbahen"], ha la amar hachi – kane; ammay? veha "eved" ka kare leh! ella "avdi" shehaya kevar, hacha name "avadayy" shehayu kevar.
Negacho shor; yom shel rabbo – lerabbo, yom shel atzmo – leatzmo. ella meatta – yom shel rabbo yissa shifcha, yom shel atzmo yissa bat chorin! issura la kaamrinan.
Ta shema: hemit mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin – noten chatzi kenas lerabbo,
b: Vachatzi chofer leyorshav. ammay? hachi name lema: yom shel rabbo – lerabbo, yom shel atzmo – leatzmo! shane hacha deka chalya karna.
Veella hechi dame dela ka chalya karna? kegon shehikkahu al yado, vetzamta yado vesofah lachazor.
Hanicha leabbaye, deamar: noten lo shevet gedola, veshevet ketanna – shappir.
Ella lerava, deamar: eno noten lo ella shivto shebbechol yom vayom; hay – shor hu, veshor eno meshallem ella nezek!
Ibbaet ema: keshehikkahu adam. vei baet ema: memra hi, umemra lerava la sevira leh.
Ibbaya lehu: meukkav get shichrur, yesh lo kenas o en lo kenas?
"Kesef sheloshim shekalim yitten ladonav" amar rachamana – vehay lav adon hu, o dilma kevan dimchussar get shichrur, adon karena beh?
Ta shema: hemit mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin – noten chatzi kenas lerabbo vachatzi chofer leyorshav. may, lav kemishna acharona?
Lo, kemishna rishona.

Ta shema: hippil et shinno vesima et eno – yotze beshinno, venoten deme eno. vei amrat yesh lo kenas, ukenas lerabbo – hasheta chavli beh acharine yahavi leh lerabbeh, chavel beh rabbeh gufeh, yahev leh ledideh?!

Dilma keman deamar eno tzarich – detanya: bechullan, eved yotze bahen lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur merabbo, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi meir omer: eno tzarich, rabbi eliezer omer: tzarich. rabbi tarfon omer: eno tzarich, rabbi akiva omer: tzarich.
Hammachriin lifne chachamim, omrim: nirim divre rabbi tarfon – beshen vaayin, hoil vetora zikketa lo, vedivre rabbi akiva – bishar evarim, hoil ukenas chachamim hu.
Kenas?! ha kerae ka darshinan! ella ema: hoil umidrash chachamim hu.
Ibbaya lehu: meukkav get shichrur, ochel bitruma o eno ochel? "kinyan kaspo" amar rachamana – vehay lav kinyan kaspo hu, o dilma, kevan dimchussar get shichrur, "kinyan kaspo" karena beh?
Ta shema, deamar rav mesharsheya: kohenet shennitarev veladah bivlad shifchatah, hare ellu ochlin bitruma, vecholkin chelek echad al haggoren. higdilu hattaarovot – meshachrerin ze et ze!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam, im yavo eliyyahu veyomar bechad minnayyhu deeved hu, "kinyan kaspo" karena beh; hacha, lav kinyan kaspo hu kelal.
Ibbaya lehu: eved shemmecharo rabbo liknas, machur o eno machur?

Tibbee lerabbi meir, tibbee lerabbanan; tibbee lerabbi meir – ad kan la kaamar rabbi meir adam makne davar shello ba laolam, ella kegon perot dekel – daavidi deatu; aval hacha – mi yemar deminnegach? veim timtza lomar deminnegach – mimmay dimshallem?

a: Dilma mode umippetar.
Vetibbee lerabbanan – ad kan la kaamri rabbanan en adam makne davar shello ba laolam – ella kegon perot dekel, dehashta miha letanhu; aval hacha – ha kae shor veha kae eved. may?
Amar rabbi abba, ta shema: "vilid bayit" – ma talmud lomar? im kinyan kesef – ochel, yelid bayit – lo kol shekken?!

Illu ken, hayiti omer: ma kinyan kesef, sheyyesh bo shave kesef – ochel; af yelid bayit, sheyyesh bo shave kesef – ochel; uminnayin sheaf al pi sheeno shave kelum? talmud lomar "yelid bayit" – mikkol makom.

Vaadayin ani omer: yelid bayit, ben sheyyesh bo shave kesef, ben sheen bo shave kesef – ochel; kinyan kesef, yesh bo shave kesef – ochel, en bo shave kesef – eno ochel; talmud lomar: "kinyan kaspo vilid beto" – ma yelid bayit, af al pi sheeno shave kelum – ochel; af kinyan kaspo, af al pi sheeno shave kelum – ochel.
Vei salka datach, eved shemmecharo rabbo liknas – machur; mi ikka avda dela mizdabban liknasa?! in, ikka eved terefa.
Veha chaze lemekam kammeh! bimnuuol umukke shechin.

Ibbaya lehu: mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin, shekkiddesh bat chorin, mahu? im timtza lomar: "ben yisrael sheamar levat yisrael: 'hitkaddeshi lechetzyi – mekuddeshet" – dechazya lechulleh; ha – la chazya lechulleh.
Veim timtza lomar: "ben yisrael hamekaddesh chatzi ishsha – enah mekuddeshet" – deshiyyer bekinyano; veha eved – lo shiyyer bekinyano. may?
Ta shema: hemit mi shechetzyo eved vechetzyo ben chorin – noten chatzi kenas lerabbo, vachatzi chofer leyorshav. vei amrat kiddushav lav kiddushin, yorshin mena leh?
Amar rav adda bar ahava: kesheasao terefa; umay "yorshav" – nafsheh.
Amar rava, shete teshuvot baddavar: chada – deyorshav" katane; veod – kofer hu, veamar resh lakish: kofer en mishtallem ella leachar mita! ella amar rava: rauy littol, veen lo.
Amar rava: keshem shehamekaddesh chatzi ishsha – enah mekuddeshet, kach chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha – en kiddusheha kiddushin.

Daresh rabba bar rav huna: keshem shehamekaddesh chatzi ishsha – enah mekuddeshet, kach chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha – enah mekuddeshet. amar leh rav chisda: mi dame? hatam shiyyer bekinyano, hacha lo shiyyer bekinyano!

Hadar okem rabba bar rav huna amora aleh, uderash: "vehammachshela hazzot tachat yadecha" – en adam omed al divre tora, ella im ken nichshal bahen; af al pi sheamru hamekaddesh chatzi ishsha – enah mekuddeshet, aval chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha – kiddusheha kiddushin. may tama? hatam shiyyer bekinyano, hacha lo shiyyer bekinyano.

Amar rav sheshet: keshem shehamekaddesh chatzi ishsha – enah mekuddeshet, kach chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha – en kiddusheha kiddushin. veim lechashcha adam lomar: ezo hi shifcha charufa – zo shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin hameoreset leeved ivri; alma bat itterose hi! emor lo: kelach etzel rabbi yishmael, shehu omer – beshifcha kenaanit hameoreset leeved ivri.
Veshifcha kenaanit bat itterose hi?! ella may it lach lememar, may "meoreset" – meyuchedet; hacha name, may "meoreset" – meyuchedet.
Amar rav chisda: chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha liruven, venishtachrera, vechazra venitkaddesha leshimon, umetu shenehem – mityaybemet lelevi,
b: Veen ani kore bah eshet shene metim; ma nafshach, i kiddushe diruven kiddushin – kiddushe deshimon lav kiddushin, vei kiddushe deshimon kiddushin – kiddushe diruven lav kiddushin.

Ittemar: chetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin shennitkaddesha liruven, venishtachrera, vechazra venitkaddesha leshimon, rav yosef bar chama amar rav nachman: paku kiddushe rishon; rabbi zera amar rav nachman: gamru kiddushe rishon.
Amar rabbi zera: kevoteh didi mistabbera, dichtiv: "lo yumetu ki lo chuppasha" – ha chuppasha, yumetu!

Amar leh abbaye: uletana deve rabbi yishmael, deamar: beshifcha kenaanit hameoreset leeved ivri; hachi name dechi chuppasha – yumetu?! ella may it lach lememar – shechuppesha vechazra venitkaddesha, hacha name – shechuppesha vechazra venitkaddesha.

Amar rav huna bar kattina amar rabbi yitzchak: maase beishsha achat shechetzyah shifcha vechetzyah bat chorin, vechafu et rabbah vaasaah bat chorin. keman? kerabbi yochanan ben beroka, deamar: al shenehem hu omer: "vayvarech otam elohim vayyomer vegomer peru urevu umilu vegomer"
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lo, minhag hefker nahagu bah.
Mishna hammocher avdo laggoyim o lechutza laaretz – yatza ben chorin.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hammocher avdo laggoyim – yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur merabbo rishon. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim – shello katav alav ono, aval katav alav ono – zehu shichruro.
May "ono"? amar rav sheshet, dichtav leh hachi: lichshettivrach mimmennu, en li esek bach.
Tanu rabbanan: lava alav min haggoy, kevan sheasa lo goy nimuso – yatza lecherut. may nimuso? amar rav huna bar yehuda: nashki.
Metiv rav sheshet: haarisin, vehachachirot, vaarise batte avot, vegoy shemmishken sadehu leyisrael; af al pi sheasa lo nimuso – petura min hammaaser.
Vei salka datach nashki, sade bat nashki hi? ella amar rav sheshet: zeman.
Kashya zeman azzeman! la kashya: ha dimta zimneh, ha dela meta zimneh.
Ella gabbe eved, dimta zimneh tzericha lememar?! ella idde veidde dela meta zimneh, vela kashya: ha legufa, veha lefera.

a: Vei baet ema: beshellava al menat lemashkeno, velo mishkeno.
Tanu rabbanan: gevao bechovo o shellekacho sikarikon, lo yatza lecherut. uvechovo lo?!
Ureminhi: hare sheansu bet hammelech gorno, im bechovo – chayyayv leasser, im baanparot – patur milleasser!
Shane hatam, deka mishtarshi leh.
Ta shema, deamar rav: hammocher avdo lefarhang goy – yatza lecherut! hatam, hava leh lefayyes velo piyyes.
Gufa – amar rav: hammocher avdo lefarhang goy – yatza lecherut. may hava leh lemebad? hava leh lefayyes, velo piyyes.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: mecharo lishloshim yom, mahu? ta shema, deamar rav: hammocher avdo lefarhang goy – yatza lecherut! hatam befarhang goy sheenah chozeret.

Mecharo chutz mimmelachto, mahu? chutz min hammitzvot, mahu? chutz mishshabbatot veyamim tovim, mahu? leger toshav, leyisrael meshummad, mahu? lechuti, mahu? peshot miha chada: ger toshav hare hu kegoy. kuti veyisrael meshummad – amri la kegoy, veamri la keyisrael.
Beo minneh merabbi amme: eved shehippil atzmo ligyaysot, veen rabbo yachol lehotzio – lo bedine yisrael velo bedine ummot haolam, mahu sheyyittol et damav?

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zerika: pok ayyen bimchilataych. nefak dak veashkach, detanya: hammocher beto legoy – damav asurin. vegoy sheanas beto shel yisrael, veen bealav yachol lehotzio – lo bedine yisrael velo bedine ummot haolam, muttar littol et damav, vechotev umaale bearkaot shellahen – mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam.
Vedilma hane mille bayit – dechevan dela saggi leh belo bayit, la ate lezabboneh; aval avda – desaggi leh bela avda, ate lezabboneh – o la.

Shelach lehu rabbi amme: "minnay amme bar natan, tora yotza lechol yisrael: eved shehippil atzmo ligyaysot, veen rabbo yachol lehotzio – lo bedine yisrael velo bedine ummot haolam, muttar littol et damav, vechotev umaale bearkaot shel goyim – mippene shehu kematztzil miyyadam.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammocher avdo legoy – konsim oto ad mea bedamav.
Davka, o lav davka? ta shema, deamar resh lakish: hammocher behema gassa legoy – konsim oto ad asara bedameha!
Vedilma shane eved, dechol yoma veyoma mafka leh mimmitzvot.

Veikka deamri, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammocher avdo legoy – konsin oto ad asara bedamav. davka o lav davka? ta shema, deamar resh lakish: hammocher behema gassa legoy – konsin oto ad mea bedameha!
Shane eved, dela hadar leh.
Ella behema tama may – mishshum dehadra leh?! likneseh tefe chad! ella eved milleta dela shechicha, umilleta dela shechicha la gazri ba rabbanan.

Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi assi: machar avdo vamet, mahu sheyyiknesu et beno acharav? im timtze lomar: "tzaram ozen bechor, vamet – kansu beno acharav" – mishshum deissura deorayyta hi, aval hacha issura derabbanan.
b: Veim timtze lomar: "kivvevn melachto bammoed, vamet – lo kansu beno acharav" – mishshum dela avad issura, hacha may? ledideh kenasu rabbanan – veha leteh; o dilma lemamoneh kenasu rabbanan – veha iteh?
Amar leh, tenetuha: sade shennitkavvevtza bashsheviit, tizzara lemotzae sheviit. nittayyeyva o niddayyeyra – lo tizzara lemotzae sheviit.
Veamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina, naktinan: hetivah vamet – beno zorah. alma ledideh kenasu rabbanan, livreh la kenasu rabbanan.

Amar abbaye, naktinan: timme teharot shel chavero, vamet – la kenasu rabbanan beno acharav. may tama? hezzek sheeno nikkar la shemeh hezzek, ukenasa derabbanan hi – ledideh kansuhu rabbanan, livreh la ka kenasu rabbanan.

O lechutza laaretz: tanu rabbanan: hammocher avdo lechutza laaretz – yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur merabbo sheni. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: peamim yatza, ufeamim lo yatza. ketzad? amar: "peloni avdi mechartihu lifloni antochi" – lo yatza. "leantochi shebbeantochya" – yatza.
Veha tanya: "mechartihu leantochi" – yatza, "leantochi hashsharuy belod" – lo yatza!
La kashya, ha deit leh beta beeretz yisrael, ha deit leh ushepiza beeretz yisrael.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: ben bavel shennasa ishsha beeretz yisrael, vehichnisa lo avadim ushefachot, vedato lachazor, mahu?
Tibbee leman deamar haddin immah, tibbee leman deamar haddin immo.
Tibbee leman deamar haddin immah – kevan dehaddin immah, kedide damu; o dilma, kevan dimshabedi leh lefera, kedideh damu?
Vetibbee leman deamar haddin immo – kevan dehaddin immo, kedideh damu; o dilma, kevan dela kane leh legufeh – kedide damu? teku.
Amar rabbi avahu, shana li rabbi yochanan: eved sheyyatza achar rabbo lesureya, umecharo sham rabbo – yatza lecherut. vehatane rabbi chiyyay: ibbed et zechuto!
La kashya, kan sheddaat rabbo lachzor, kan sheen daat rabbo lachzor.
Vehatanya: yotze haeved achar rabbo lesureya – "yotze"?! la saggi dela nafek?! vehatnan: veen hakkol motziin!
Ella yatza haeved achar rabbo lesureya, umecharo rabbo sham; im daat rabbo lachzor – kofin oto, veim en daat rabbo lachzor – en kofin oto.
Amar rav anan, shemait minneh demar shemuel tarte: chada – hach; veiddach – deittemar: hammocher sadehu bishnat hayyovel atzmah; rav amar: mechura, veyotza. ushemuel amar: enah mechura kol ikkar.
Bachada – hadri zevine, uvachada – la hadri zevine; vela yadana he minnayyhu.

Amar rav yosef: nichze anan, middetane bevarayyta: hammocher avdo lechutza laaretz – yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur merabbo sheni. shema minna kanyeh rabbo sheni, vela hadri zevine; vechi amar shemuel hatam enah mechura – umaot chozrin.

a: Verav anan – barayyta la shemia leh;

Vei middishmuel – mimmay deenah mechura umaot chozrin, dilma enah mechura umaot mattana ninhu – midde dehave ammekaddesh et achoto, deittemar: hamekaddesh et achoto, rav amar: maot – chozrin, ushemuel amar: maot mattana.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: may chazet dekansinan lelokeach? nikneseh lemocher! amar leh: lav achbera gannav ella chora gannav. amar leh: i lav achbera, chora mena leh?
Mistabbera, hecha deikka issura hatam kansinan.

Hahu avda daarak mechutza laaretz laaretz. azal mareh abbatreh, ata lekammeh derabbi amme, amar leh: nichtov lach shetara addemeh, uchetov leh gitta decheruta. vei la, mafkana leh minnach midderabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya.

Detanya: "lo yeshvu beartzecha pen yachatiu otcha li" – yachol begoy shekkibbel alav shello laavod avoda zara hakkatuv medabber, talmud lomar: "lo tasgir eved el adonav asher yinnatzel elecha meim adonav", may takkanato? "immecha yeshev bekirbecha vegomer".
Vekashya leh lerabbi yoshiyya: hay "meim adonav"?! "meim aviv" mibbee leh! ella amar rabbi yoshiyya: bemocher avdo lechutza laaretz hakkatuv medabber.

Vekashya leh lerabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya: hay "asher yinnatzel elecha"?! "asher yinnatzel meimmecha" mibbee leh! ella amar rabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya: beeved shebbarach mechutza laaretz laaretz hakkatuv medabber.

Tanya iddach: "lo tasgir eved el adonav" – rabbi omer: belokeach eved al menat leshachrero hakkatuv medabber. hechi dame? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: dichtav leh hachi: "lichsheekkachacha, hare atzmecha kanuy lecha meachshav".

Rav chisda arak leh avda leve chutae, shelach lehu: [a]hedru nihali. shelachu leh: "lo tasgir eved el adonav". shelach lehu: vechen taase lachamoro vechen taase lesimlato vechen taase lechol avedat achicha". shelachu leh: vehachtiv: "lo tasgir eved el adonav", shelach lehu: hahu, beeved shebbarach mechutza laaretz laaretz, vechidrabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya.
Umay shena dishlach lehu kidrabbi achay berabbi yoshiyya? mishshum demashma lehu kerae.

Abbaye irchas leh chamara be chutae, shelach lehu: shadderu li. shelachu leh: shelach simana. shelach lehu: dechiuora kereseh. shelachu leh: i lav denachmani at, la hava meshaddarna leh nihalach; attu kulle chamare lav keresayyhu chivvavre ninhu?!
Mishna en podin et hashshevuyin yater al kede demehen, mippene tikkun haolam. veen mavrichin et hashshevuyin, mippene tikkun haolam. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mippene takkanat hashshevuyin.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: hay "mippene tikkun haolam" – mishshum ducheka detzibbura hu, o dilma mishshum dela ligrevu velayyto tefe?
Ta shema: delevi bar darga parka livratteh bitlesar alfe dinre zahav.
Amar abbaye: uman lema lan devirtzon chachamim avad? dilma shello birtzon chachamim avad.
Veen mavrichin et hashshevuyin mippene tikkun haolam. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mippene takkanat shevuyin: may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu, delekka ella chad.

Benateh derav nachman bachashan kidra bidayyhu. kashya leh lerav ilish, ketiv: "adam echad meelef matzati veishsha vechol elle lo matzati", ha ikka benateh derav nachman! gerama lehu milleta veishtavyayn, veishteviy ihu name bahadayyhu.

Yoma chad hava yatev gabbeh hahu gavra, dahava yada belishshana detzippore. ata orva veka kare leh. amar leh: may kaamar? amar leh: "ilish berach, ilish berach". amar: orva shakkara hu vela samechna aleh.

Addehachi ata yona veka karya. amar leh: may kaamra? amar leh: "ilish berach, ilish berach". amar: keneset yisrael keyona metila, shema minna mitrechish li nissa. amar: ezil echze benateh derav nachman, i kayyman behemanutayyhu – ahderinhu.

Amar: neshe, kol mille deit lehu sadran lahadade bevet hakkisse. shaminhu dekaamran: ade guverin unehardae guverin, lema lehu leshavoyayhu delirachakinhu mehacha, dela leto inashin velishmei velifrekinan.
Kam, arak, ata ihu vehahu gavra. ledideh itrechish leh nissa avar bemabbara, vehahu gavra ashkechu vekatlu. ki hadran veatan, amar: havo ka vachashan kidra bichshafim.
Mishna veen lokchin sefarim, tefillin umezuzot min haggoyim yoter al kede demehen,
b: Mippene tikkun haolam.
Gemara amar leh rav budeya lerav ashe: yater al kede demehen hu deen lokchin, ha bichde demehen – lokchin; shema minna sefer tora shennimtza beyad goy – korin bo? dilma lignoz.
Amar rav nachman, naktinan: sefer tora shekketavo min – yissaref, ketavo goy – yigganez. nimtza beyad min – yigganez. nimtza beyad goy – amri la yigganez, veamri la korin bo.
Sefer tora shekketavo goy – tane chada: yissaref, vetanya iddach: yigganez, vetanya iddach: korin bo!
La kashya, ha detanya "yissaref" – rabbi eliezer hi, deamar: setam machshevet goy laavoda zara.

Veha detanya "yigganez" – hay tanna hu, detane rav hamenuna bereh derava mippashruneya: sefer tora, tefillin umezuzot shekketavan min, umasor, goy, veeved, ishsha, vekatan, vechuti, veyisrael meshummad – pesulin; shenneemar: "ukeshartam"–"uchetavtam" – kol sheyyeshno bikshira yeshno bichtiva, vechol sheeno bikshira eno bichtiva.

Veha detanya "korin bo" – hay tanna hu, detanya: lokchin sefarim min haggoyim bechol makom, uvilvad sheyyihyu ketuvin kehilchatan. umaase begoy echad betzaydan shehaya kotev sefarim, vehittir rabban shimon ben gamliel likkach mimmennu.
Verabban shimon ben gamliel – ibbud lishman bae, ketiva lishman la bae?!

Detanya: tzippan zahav o shettala alehen or behema temea – pesulot. or behema tehora – kesherot, veaf al pi shello ibbedan lishman. rabbi shimon ben gamliel omer: afillu or behema tehora – pesulot, ad sheyyeabbeden lishman.
Amar rabba bar shemuel: beger shechazar lesoro. lesoro?! kol shekken dehave leh min! amar rav ashe: shechozer lesoro mishshum yira.
Tanu rabbanan: maalin bidmehen, ad kede tarpaik. may tarpaik? amar rav sheshet: istera.
Hahi tayyayta deayytay chayyta ditfille lekammeh deabbaye. amar la: yahavat li resh resh betamre? immalya zihara, shekala shedatinhu benahara. amar: la ibbeay li lezalzolinhu beappa kulle hay.
Mishna hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra – lo yachzir. mishshum neder – lo yachzir. rabbi yehuda omer: kol neder sheyyadu bo rabbim – lo yachzir, veshello yadu bo rabbim – yachzir.
Rabbi meir omer: kol neder shetztzarich chakirat chacham – lo yachzir, vesheeno tzarich chakirat chacham – yachzir. amar rabbi elazar: lo asru ze ella mippene ze.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: maase betzaydan, beechad sheamar leishto: "kuvnnam im eni megarshich", vegershah, vehittiru lo chachamim sheyyachzirenna, mippene tikkun haolam.
Gemara amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: vehu sheamar lah: "mishshum shem ra ani motziech";

a: "Mishshum neder ani motziech" – kasavar: tama may – mishshum kilkula; i amar la hachi – matze mekalkel la, vei la – la matze mekalkel la.

Ikka deamri, amar rav yosef bar minyome amar rav nachman: tzarich sheyyomar lah: "hevi yodaat shemmishshum shem ra ani motziech umishshum neder ani motziech" – kasavar: tama may – kede shello yehu benot yisrael perutzot baarayot uvindarim; hilkach tzarich lememar la hachi.
Tanya kelishshana kamma, vetanya kelishshana batra.

Tanya kelishshana kamma – amar rabbi meir: mippene ma amru hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra lo yachzir, umishshum neder lo yachzir? shemma telech vetinnase leacher, venimtzeu devarim baddain, veyomar: "illu hayiti yodea shekken hu, afillu im hayu notnim li mea mane – lo hayiti megarshah"; venimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerin; lefichach omrim lo: heve yodea, shehammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra – lo yachzir, umishshum neder – lo yachzir.

Tanya kelishshana batra – amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose: mippene ma amru hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra lo yachzir, umishshum neder lo yachzir? shello yehu benot yisrael perutzot baarayot uvindarim. lefichach omrim lo, emor lah: "have yodaat shemmishshum shem ra ani motziech umishshum neder ani motziech".

Rabbi yehuda omer: kol neder sheyyedu bo rabbim – lo yachzir, veshello yadu bo rabbim – yachzir: amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may tama derabbi yehuda? dichtiv: "velo hikkum bene yisrael ki nishbeu lahem nesie haeda".
Verabbanan: hatam, mi chala shevua illavayyhu kelal?! kevan daamaru lehu: "meeretz rechoka banu" – velo bau, la chayyla shevua illavayyhu kelal; vehay dela katlinhu – mishshum kedushshat hashshem.
Vechamma rabbim? rav nachman amar shelosha, rabbi yitzchak amar asara.
Rav nachman amar shelosha, "yamim" – shenayim, "rabbim" – shelosha. rabbi yitzchak amar asara, dichtiv: "eda".
Rabbi meir omer: kol neder shetztzarich vechulei: tanya, rabbi elazar omer: lo asru "tzarich" ella mippene "sheeno tzarich".
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbi meir savar: adam rotze, shettitbazze ishto bevet din;
Verabbi elazar savar: en adam rotze shettitbazze ishto bevet din.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: maase betzaydan vechulei: may tanna dekatane maase?

Chassore michassera vehachi katane: bamme devarim amurim – keshennadra hi, aval nadar ihu – yachzir; veamar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: maase name betzaydan, beechad sheamar leishto: "kunnam im eni megarshich", vegershah, vehittiru lo chachamim sheyyachzirenna – mippene tikkun haolam.
b: May "kuvnnam"? amar rav huna, beomer: "yeasru kol perot shebbaolam alay im eni megarshah".
Vehittiru lo sheyyachzirenna: peshita! mahu detema ligzor mishshum derabbi natan – detanya, rabbi natan omer: hannoder – keillu bana bama, vehamekayyeymo – keillu hikriv aleha korban; ka mashma lan.
Mippene tikkun haolam: may tikkun haolam ikka? amar rav sheshet: aresha.
Ravina amar: leolam assefa, vehachi katane: en bazo mippene tikkun haolam.
Mishna hammotzi et ishto mishshum aylonit, rabbi yehuda omer: lo yachzir. vachachamim omrim: yachzir.
Nisset leacher vehayu lah banim hemennu, vehi tovaat ketubbatah; amar rabbi yehuda, omer la: shetikutich yafa middibburich.
Gemara lememra derabbi yehuda chayesh lekilkula, verabbanan la chayyshi lekilkula?! veha ippecha shaminan lehu!

Ditnan: hammotzi et ishto mishshum shem ra – lo yachzir, umishshum neder – lo yachzir. rabbi yehuda omer: kol neder sheyyadu bo rabbim – lo yachzir, veshello yadu bo rabbim – yachzir. alma [rabbanan chayyshi lekilkula], verabbi yehuda la chayesh lekilkula!
Amar shemuel: efoch.

Veha middekatane sefa: nisset leacher vehayu lah banim hemennu, vehi tovaat ketubbatah; amar rabbi yehuda, omer lah: "shetikutich yafa middibburich" – mikkelal derabbi yehuda chayesh lekilkula! ha name efoch.
Abbaye amar: leolam la tefoch, verabbi yehuda behahi savar la kerabbi meir vesavar la kerabbi elazar – betzarich savar la kerabbi elazar, besheeno tzarich savar la kerabbi meir.
Amar rava: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda kashya, derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya?!

Ella amar rava: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya – kidshanninan. derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya, man chachamim – rabbi meir, deamar: baenan tenay kaful, vehacha bemay askinan – bidla kafleh litnaeh.
Mishna hammocher et atzmo veet banav laggoyim – en podin oto, aval podin et habbanim leachar mitat avihen.
Gemara amar rav assi: vehu shemmachar veshana veshillesh.

Hanhu bene be michse, deyazfi zuze miggoyim vela hava lehu lemifreinhu. atu veka garvi lehu, ato lekammeh derav huna. amar lehu: may ebed lechu, ditnan: hammocher et atzmo veet banav laggoyim – en podin oto.
Amar leh rabbi abba: limmadtani rabbenu, vehu shemmachar veshana veshillesh! amar leh: hane mirgal regili deavdi hachi.
Hahu gavra dezabben nafsheh leludae. ata lekammeh derabbi amme, amar leh:

a: Pirkan! amar leh: tenan: hammocher atzmo veet banav laggoyim – en podin oto, aval podin et habbanim – mishshum kilkula, vechol shekken hacha deikka ketala.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerabbi amme: hay yisrael mumar hu, deka chazu leh dekaachel nevelot uterefot! amar lehu: ema leteavon hu dekaachel.
Amaru leh: veha zimnin deikka hettera veissura kammeh, veshavek hettera veachel issura! amar leh: zil, la ka shavki li deefrekinnach.
Resh lakish zabben nafsheh leludae, shekal bahadeh chayyta vegulgulta, amar: gemiri deyoma batra kol devae minnayyhu avdi leh, ki hechi delechul addemeh.

Yoma batra amaru leh: may nicha lach? amar lehu: baena ekmetinchu veotvinchu, vechol chad minnayychu emcheye chayyta ufalga. kamtinhu veotvinhu, kol chad minnayyhu kad machyeh chad chayyta nefak nishmeteh. charkinneh leshinneh, amar leh: achoche ka mechayyeychat bi? akkatti pash lach gabbay palga dechayyta. katlinhu kullehu.
Nefak vaata, yatev kaachel veshate. amara leh beratte: la baet midde lemizge aleh? amar la: bitti, keresi kari. ki nach nafsheh shevak kabba demorika, kera annafsheh: "veazvu laacherim chelam".
Mishna hammocher et sadehu legoy – lokeach umevi mimmennu bikkurim, mippene tikkun haolam.

Gemara amar rabba: af al pi sheen kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lehafekia midde maaser, shenneemar: "ki li haaretz" – li kedushshat haaretz; aval yesh kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lachpor bah borot shichin umearot, shenneemar: "hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai vehaaretz natan livne adam".

Verabbi elazar omer: af al pi sheyyesh kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lehafekia mide maaser, shenneemar: "degancha" – velo degan goy; aval en kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lachpor bah borot shichin umearot, shenneemar: "laAdonai haaretz".
Bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: "degancha" – velo degan goy, umar savar: diggunecha, velo diggun goy.
Amar rabba: mena amena la? ditnan: halleket vehashshichcha vehappea shel goy – chayyayvin bemaaser, ella im ken hifkir.
Hechi dame? illema deyisrael velaykketinhu goy – "ella im ken hifkir"?! ha mafkeri vekayymi! ella lav degoy – velakketinhu yisrael;
Tama dehifkir, ha lo hifkir – chayyayv!
La, leolam deyisrael velakketinhu goy, udeka amrat: ha mafkeri vekayymi, nehi demafkeri addata deyisrael, addata degoy mi mafkeri?!
Ta shema: yisrael shellakach sade miggoy ad shello hevia shelish, vechazar umecharah lo mishshehevia shelish – chayyevet bemaaser, shekkevar nitchayyeyva. nitchayyeyva – in, lo nitchayyeyva – la!
Hacha bemay askinan – besureya, vekasavar: kibbush yachid la shemeh kibbush.
Ta shema: yisrael vegoy shellakchu sade beshuttafut –
b: Tevel vechullin meoravin ze baze, divre rabbi. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shel goy – patur, veshel yisrael – chayyayv.
Ad kan la peligi ella demar savar "yesh berera". umar savar "en berera"; aval dechulle alma – yesh kinyan legoy beeretz yisrael lehafekia miyyad maaser!
Hacha name besureya; vekasavar kibbush yachid la shemeh kibbush.
Amar rav chiyyay bar avin, ta shema: hammocher sadehu legoy – lokeach umevi bikkurim mippene tikkun haolam. mippene tikkun haolam – in, middeorayyta – la!
Amar rav ashe: shete takkanot havo – meikkara havo mayyti middeorayyta; kevan dachazo deka mikkeri umezabbeni, desavri bikdushetayyhu kayyman, takkinu lehu dela layto;
Kevan dachazo deman dela saggi leh – mezabben, veka mishtakkean beyad goyim, hadar takkinu lehu delayto.
Ittemar: hammocher sadehu leferot, rabbi yochanan amar: mevi vekore. resh lakish amar: mevi veeno kore.
Rabbi yochanan amar mevi vekore – kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame. resh lakish amar mevi veeno kore – kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame.
Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: "ulevetcha" – melammed, sheadam mevi bikkure ishto, vekore.
Amar leh: shane hatam, dichtiv "ulevetecha".

Veikka deamri: etiveh rabbi shimon ben lakish lerabbi yochanan: "ulevetecha" – melammed, sheadam mevi bikkure ishto vekore – hatam hu dichtiv "ulevetecha", aval bealma – la! amar leh: tama didi name mehacha kaamena.
Etiveh: haya ba badderech uvikkure ishto beyado, veshama shemmeta ishto – mevi vekore. meta – in, lo meta – la!
Hu haddin deaf al gav delo meta; umeta itztericha leh – salka datach amena ligzor mishshum derabbi yose bar chanina –

Deamar rabbi yose bar chanina: betzaran, veshiggeran beyad shaliach, umet shaliach badderech – mevi veeno kore, shenneemar: "velakachta"–"veheveta" – ad shettehe lekicha vahavaa beechad; ka mashma lan.
Veazdu letamayyhu, deittemar: hammocher sadehu

a: Bizman shehayyovel noheg, rabbi yochanan amar: mevi vekore. resh lakish amar: mevi veeno kore.
Rabbi yochanan amar mevi vekore – kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame. resh lakish amar mevi veeno kore – kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame.
Utzericha. dei ittemar behahi, behahi kaamar resh lakish, dechi ka nachet – addata defera ka nachet; aval behach – deaddata degufeh ka nachet, ema mode leh lerabbi yochanan.
Vei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi yochanan, aval behach ema mode leh leresh lakish; tzericha.
Ta shema: hakkone ilan vekarkao – mevi vekore! hacha bemay askinan – bizman sheen hayyovel noheg.
Ta shema: hakkone shene ilanot betoch sadehu shel chavero – mevi veeno kore. ha shelosha – mevi vekore! hacha name bizman sheen hayyovel noheg.
Vehasheta deamar rav chisda: machloket beyyovel sheni, aval beyyovel rishon – divre hakkol mevi vekore, deakkatti la semach datayyhu; la kashya: ha beyovel rishon, ha beyovel sheni.
Lema ketannae: minnayin lallokeach sade meaviv, vehikdishah, veachar kach met aviv – minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza?
Talmud lomar: "im et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato" – sade sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza, yatzta zo sheruya lihyot sede achuzza, divre rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon.

Rabbi meir omer: minnayin lallokeach sade meaviv umet aviv veachar kach hikdishah, minnayin shettehe lefanav kisde achuzza? talmud lomar: "im et sede miknato asher lo missede achuzzato" – sade sheenah sede achuzza, yatzta zo shehi sede achuzza. veillu lerabbi yehuda verabbi shimon, met aviv veachar kach hikdishah – la tzericha kera.
May, lav beha kamippalgi? derabbi meir savar: kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame, uveha – bemitat aviv hu dela yaret vela midde, vehilkach met aviv veachar kach hikdishah – tzerich kera;

Rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon savri: kinyan perot lav kekinyan hagguf dame, uveha – bemitat aviv hasheta hu deka yaret, vehilkach met aviv veachar kach hikdishah – la tzericha kera; vechi itzterich kera – lehikdishah veachar kach met aviv hu deitzterich.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: leolam ema lach, bealma kasavri rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame. vehacha, rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon kera ashkachu uderush – lichtov rachamana "im et sede miknato asher lo achuzzato"; may "missede achuzzato"? sade sheenah reuya lihyot sede achuzza – yatzta zo, sheruya lihyot sede achuzza.

Amar rav yosef: i lav deamar rabbi yochanan kinyan perot kekinyan hagguf dame, lo matza yadav veraglav bevet hammidrash. deamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: haachin shechalku – lakochot hen, umachzirin ze laze beyovel;
Vei salka datach lav kekinyan hagguf dame, la mashkachat demayyte bikkurim ella chad bar chad ad yehoshua bin nun!
Amar rava: kera umatnita mesayyeyi leh leresh lakish. kera –
b: "Bemispar shene tevuot yimkor lach".
Matnita – detanya: bechor notel pi shenayim besade hachozeret leaviv beyovel.
Amar abbaye, naktinan: baal benichse ishto tzarich hareshaa.
Vela amaran ella dela nachet appere, aval nachet appere, miggo demishtae dina appere – mishtae dina aggufa.
Hadaran alach hashsholeach
Hannizzakin shamin lahen beiddit, uvaal chov bevenonit, uchetubbat ishsha bezibburit. rabbi meir omer: af ketubbat ishsha bevenonit.
En nifrain minnechasim meshuebadim bimkom sheyyesh nechasim bene chorin, vaafillu hen zibburit.
En nifrain minnichse yetomin ella min hazzibburit.
En motziin laachilat perot, velishvach karkaot,
Velimzon haishsha vehabbanot – minnechasim meshuebadin, mippene tikkun haolam.
Vehammotze metzia – lo yishshava, mippene tikkun haolam.
Gemara mippene tikkun haolam?! deorayyta hi, dichtiv: "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem"!
Amar abbaye: la tzericha ella lerabbi yishmael, deamar middeorayyta bidnizzak shayyminan; ka mashma lan mippene tikkun haolam shayyminan bidmazzik.

May rabbi yishmael? detanya: "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem" – metav sadehu shel nizzak, umetav karmo shel nizzak, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: lo ba hakkatuv ella lagbot lannizzakin min haiddit, vekal vachomer lahekdesh.

Ulerabbi yishmael, achal shemena – meshallem shemena; achal kechusha – meshallem shemena?! amar rav idi bar avin: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheachla aruga ben haarugot, vela yadinan i kechusha achal i shemena achal, dimshallem leh mimmetav.
Amar rava: illu yadinan dichchusha achal – meshallem kechusha; hasheta dela yadinan – meshallem shemena?! hammotzi mechavero alav haraya! ella amar rav acha bar yaakov:

a: Hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehayta iddit denizzak kezibburit demazzik; rabbi yishmael savar: bidnizzak shayyminan, verabbi akiva savar: bidmazzik shayyminan.
May tama derabbi yishmael? neemra "sade" lematta, veneemra "sade" lemala; ma sade haamura lemala – denizzak, af sade haamura lematta – denizzak.
Verabbi akiva savar: "metav sadehu yeshallem" – dehaych deka meshallem.

Verabbi yishmael: ahanay gezera shava veahani kera; ahanay gezera shava – lichdaamaran. ahani kera – dei it leh lemazzik iddit vezibburit, vezibburit dideh la shavya keiddit denizzak – dimshallem leh mimmetav.
Rabbi akiva omer: lo ba hakkatuv ella lagbot lannizzakin min haiddit, vekal vachomer lahekdesh.
May kal vachomer lahekdesh? ilema denagcheh tora didan letora dehekdesh, "shor reehu" amar rachamana – velo shor shel hekdesh!
Ella laomer "hare alay mane levedek habbayit", deate gizbar veshakel meiddit.

Lo yehe ella baal chov, uvaal chov dino bevenonit! vechi tema: kasavar rabbi akiva baal chov shakel beiddit kenizzakin, ikka lemifrach: ma levaal chov shekken yippa kocho benizzakin, tomar behekdesh shekken hora kocho benizzakin!
