Leolam denagcheh tora didan letora dehekdesh, verabbi akiva savar la kerabbi shimon ben menasya – detanya, rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: shor shel hekdesh shennagach leshor shel hedyot – patur, veshel hedyot shennagach leshor shel hekdesh – ben tam uven muad, meshallem nezek shalem.
I hachi, mimmay dividdit denizzak kezibburit demazzik peligi? dilma dechulle alma bidnizzak shayyminan, vehacha biflugeta derabbi shimon ben menasya verabbanan kamippalgi –
Derabbi akiva savar la kerabbi shimon ben menasya, verabbi yishmael savar la kerabbanan!
Im ken, may "lo ba hakkatuv"? veod, may "kal vachomer lahekdesh"? veod, ha amar rav ashe,
b: Tanya behedya: "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem" – metav sadehu shel nizzak, umetav karmo shel nizzak, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: metav sadehu shel mazzik, umetav karmo shel mazzik.

Ravina amar: leolam matnitin rabbi akiva hi, deamar middeorayyta bidmazzik shayyminan; verabbi shimon hi – dedaresh tama dikra, uma taam kaamar – ma taam hannizzakin shamin lahen beiddit? mippene tikkun haolam.

Detanya, amar rabbi shimon: mippene ma amru hannizzakin shamin lahen beiddit? mippene haggazlanim umippene hachamsanin, kede sheyyomar adam: lama ani gozel velama ani chomes? lemachar bet din yordin linchasay venotlin sade naa shelli, vesomchim al ma shekkatuv battora: "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem"; lefichach amru: hannizzakin – shamin lahen beiddit.
Mippene ma amru baal chov bevenonit? kede shello yire adam lachavero sade naa vedira naa, veyomar: ekpotz vealvennu, kede sheegbennu bechovi; lefichach amru: baal chov bevenonit.
Ella meatta, yehe bezibburit! im ken – atta noel delet bifne lovin.

Ketubbat ishsha – bezibburit, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: bevenonit. amar rabbi shimon: mippene ma amru ketubbat ishsha bezibburit? sheyyoter mimma shehaish rotze lissa, haishsha rotza linnase.
Davar acher: ishsha yotza lirtzonah veshello lirtzonah, vehaish eno motziah ella lirtzono.

May davar acher? vechi tema, ki hechi dechi mappek la ihu – takkinu la rabbanan ketubba minneh; ki nafka ihi name – litakkeni leh rabbanan ketubba minna? ta shema: ishsha yotza lirtzonah veshello lirtzonah, vehaish eno motzi ella lirtzono – efshar dimshahe la begitta.
Ketubbat ishsha bezibburit. amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: la amaran ella miyyatme, aval minneh dideh – bevenonit.
Miyyatme?! may irya ketubbat ishsha? afillu kol mille name, deha tenan: en nifraim minnichse yetomim ella min hazzibburit! ella lav minneh?
Leolam miyyatme, uchetubbat ishsha itztericha leh – salka datach amena: mishshum chinna, akkilu rabbanan gabba; ka mashma lan.

Amar rava: ta shema, rabbi meir omer: ketubbat ishsha – bevenonit. mimman? ilema miyyatme, let leh lerabbi meir ha ditnan: en nifraim minnichse yetomim ella min hazzibburit?! ella lav minneh? mikkelal derabbanan savri bezibburit!
La; leolam miyyatme, veshane ketubbat ishsha – mishshum chinna.

Amar abbaye, ta shema: hannizzakin shamin lahen beiddit, uvaal chov – bevenonit, uchetubbat ishsha – bezibburit. mimman? ilema miyyatme, may irya ketubbat ishsha? afillu kol hane name! ella lav minneh?
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shennaasa arev lenizke veno, levaal chov beno velichtubbat kallato;

Vehay ki dineh, vehay ki dineh; nizzakin uvaal chov, demechayyim gavu, ihu name ki magbe – kemechayyim magbe. ketubbat ishsha, dilachar mita gavya, uleachar mita mimman gavya – miyyatme; ihu name ki magbe – kilachar mita magbe.
Vetippok leh dearev dichtubba lo mishtabed! bekabbelan.
Hanicha leman deamar: kabbelan, af al gav delet leh nichse lelove – mishtabad, shappir; ella leman deamar: i it leh – mishtabad, i let leh – la mishtabad, may ikka lememar?
Ibbaet ema: bedahavo leh veishteduf.
Veibbaet ema: kol legabbe bereh, shabode meshabad nafsheh.
Ittemar: arev dichtubba – divre hakkol la mishtabad;

a: Kabbelan devaal chov – divre hakkol mishtabad; arev devaal chov, vekabbelan dichtubba – peligi; ikka leman deamar: af al gav delet leh nichse lelove – mishtabad, veikka leman deamar: i it leh – mishtabad, i let leh – la mishtabad.
Vehilcheta: bechullehu, af al gav delet leh – mishtabad; bar mearev dichtubba, deaf al gav deit leh – la mishtabad.
May tama? mitzva hu daavad, vela midde chassera.
Amar ravina: ta shema meikkara detakkantin – yoter mimma shehaish rotze lissa, ishsha rotza linnase. vei salka datach miyyatme, hay mishshum deyatme hu! teyuveta demar zutera teyuveta.
Amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman, mishshemeh derav nachman: shetar chov hayyotze al hayyetomin, af al pi shekkatuv bo shevach, eno gove ella min hazzibburit.
Amar abbaye: tidda – devaal chov dineh bevenonit, umiyyatme bezibburit.

Amar leh rava: hachi hasheta?! baal chov dineh middeorayyta bezibburit! kidulla – deamar ulla: devar tora, baal chov bezibburit, shenneemar: "bachutz taamod vehaish vegomer" – ma darko shel ish lehotzi, pachut shebbakkelim; uma taam amru baal chov bevenonit? kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin – vegabbe yatme okmu rabbanan addeorayyta;
Ella hacha, kevan dedineh middeorayyta beiddit, afillu miyyatme name beiddit!
Ulerava, vehatane avram chozaa: en nifrain minnichse yetomin ella min hazzibburit, vaafillu hen nizzakin. veha nizzakin – dinan middeorayyta beiddit!
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehayta iddit denizzak kezibburit demazzik;
Verabbi yishmael hi, deamar: middeorayyta bidnizzak shayyminan, umippene tikkun haolam takkinu rabbanan bidmazzik – vegabbe yatme okmu rabbanan addeorayyta.
Ini?! vehatane rabbi eliezer nayotaa: en nifrain minnichse yetomim ella min hazzibburit, vaafillu hen iddit. may "afillu hen iddit"? lav af al gav dichtiv iddit bishtara?!
La; may "iddit" – shefay iddit, kidrava –
Deamar rava: hizzik zibburit – gove min haiddit. shefay iddit, gove min habbenonit. vegabbe yatme okmu rabbanan addeorayyta.

En nifrain minnichse yetomin ella min hazzibburit: bae rav achadvuy bar amme: "yetomim" sheamru – ketannim, o afillu gedolim? takkanta hi daavud rabbanan gabbe yatme – liktannim avud rabbanan, ligdolim la avud rabbanan;
O dilma – mishshum dela massek addata demalve demit love venafli nichse kamme yatme; dehave leh noel delet; hilkach afillu gedolim name?
Ta shema, detane abbaye kashshisha: yetomin sheamru – gedolim, veen tzarich lomar ketannim.
Vedilma hane mille leinyan shevua – degadol bemille daavu kekatan dame; aval leinyan zibburit – la.
Vehilcheta:
b: Yetomin sheamru – gedolim, veen tzarich lomar ketannim; ben lishvua ben lezibburit.
En nifrain minnechasim meshuebadim bimkom sheyyesh bene chorin. bae rav achadvuy bar amme: bemattana heach?

Takkanta hu daavud rabbanan – mishshum peseda delakochot, aval mattana, delekka peseda delakochot – la; o dilma mattana name, i lav deit leh hanaa minneh – la yahev leh mattana, vehilkach ki peseda delakochot dame?

Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe, ta shema, shechiv mera sheamar: "tenu matayim zuz lifloni, vshlosh meot lifloni, vearba meot lifloni" – en omrim: kol hakkodem bishtar zacha; lefichach, yatza alav shetar chov – gove mikkullan.

Aval im amar: "tenu matayim zuz lifloni, veacharav lifloni, veacharav lifloni" – omrim: kol hakkodem bishtar zacha. lefichach, yatza alav shetar chov – gove min haacharon. en lo – gove mishshellefanav. en lo – gove mishshellifne fanav.
Veaf al gav dekamma benonit uvatra zibburit – mizzibburit gave, mibbenonit la gave. shema minna, bemattana name avud rabbanan takkanta.
Hacha bemay askinan – bevaal chov. veha "tenu" kaamar! "tenu" bechovi.
Velichze shetara deman kadem! delekka shetara. veha "kol hakkodem bishtar" kaamar! bishtar pekadta.
Veibbaet ema: afillu mattana name. vela kashya – may "gove min haacharon"? en nifsad ella acharon.
Veibbaet ema: deshavu kullehu lahadade.
En motziin laachilat perot. may tama? amar ulla amar resh lakish: lefi sheen ketuvin.
Amar leh rabbi abba leulla: veha mezon haishsha vehabbanot, dichman dichtivi damu, vekatane: en motziin!
Amar leh: hatam, meikkara hachi ittakkun – ketuvin hen etzel bene chorin, veen ketuvin hen etzel meshuebadin.

Vechen amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: lefi sheen ketuvin. amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi: veha mezon haishsha vehabbanot, dichman dichtivi damu, vekatane: en motziin! amar leh: meikkara hachi ittakkun – ketuvin hen etzel bene chorin, veen ketuvin hen etzel meshuebadin.
Rabbi chanina amar: lefi sheen ketzuvin.
Ibbaya lehu: lerabbi chanina – ketzuvin uchetuvin bae,

a: O dilma ketzuvin, veaf al pi sheenan ketuvim?
Ta shema, deittemar: mi shemmet vehinniach shete banot uven, vekadma harishona venatla issur nechasim, velo hispika sheniyya ligbot ad shemmet habben.
Amar rabbi yochanan: sheniyya vittera. veamar lo rabbi chanina, gedola mizzo amru: motziin lefarnasa veen motziin limzonot; veat amrat sheniyya vittera?!
Veha parnasa – demikatz kayytza, michtav la ketiva; veka motzia!
Shane parnasa, kevan deit la kala, keman dichtiva dame.
Metiv rav huna bar manoach: metu – benotehen nizzonot minnechasim bene chorin,
Vehi nizzonet minnechasim meshuebadim – mippene shehi kevaalat chov!
Hacha bemay askinan – beshekkanu miyyado.
I hachi, banot name! beshekkanu lazo, velo kanu lazo.
May paska? bat ishto, dahavay bishat kinyan – mahane la kinyan; bitto, dela havay bishat kinyan – la mahane lah kinyan.
Mi la askinan dahavo tarvayyhu bishat kinyan – vehechi dame, degarsha veahdera?!
Ella bitto – devitnay bet din kaachla, la mahane la kinyan; bat ishto – delav bitnay bet din kaachla, mahane la kinyan.
Vechi migra gara?! ella bitto – kevan devitnay bet din kaachla, emar tzerare atpesa.
Ta shema, amar rabbi natan: ematay – bizman shekkadam mikkacho shel sheni leshivcho shel rishon;
Aval kadam shivcho shel rishon lemikkacho shel sheni – gove minnechasim meshuebadim. alma mishshum dela kadem hu!
Tannae hi, detanya: en motziin laachilat perot, velishvach karkaot, velimzon ishsha vehabbanot – minnechasim meshuebadim, mippene tikkun haolam; lefi sheen ketuvin.
Amar rabbi yose: vechi ma tikkun haolam yesh bazo? vahalo en ketzuvin!

Vehammotze metzia lo yishshava. amar rabbi yitzchak: "shene kisin keshurin matzata li"; vehalla omer: "lo matzati ella echad" – nishba. "shene shevavrim keshurin matzata li"; vehalla omer: "lo haya ella echad" – eno nishba.
May tama? shevorin minnatchi mehadade, kisin la minnatchi mehadade.
"Shene shevorin keshurin matzata"; vehalla omer: "matzati vehechzarti lach echad mehen" – hare ze nishba.
Verabbi yitzchak – let leh "hammotze metzia la yishshava – mippene tikkun haolam"?!
b: Hu deamar, kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov – detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: peamim sheadam nishba al taanat atzmo. ketzad? "mane leavich beyadi, veheechaltiv peras" – hare ze nishba. veze hu shennishba al taanat atzmo.
Vachachamim omrim: eno ella kemeshiv aveda, ufatur.
Verabbi eliezer ben yaakov – let leh: "meshiv aveda – patur"?! amar rav: betoano katan.
Katan, midde meshasha it beh?! vehatnan: en nishbain al taanat cheresh, shote vekatan!
May "katan" – gadol; veammay kare leh "katan"? dilgabbe mille deaviv, katan hu.
I hachi, taanat atzmo?! taanat acherim hu! taanat acherim, vehodaat atzmo.

Kullehu taanata name, taanat acherim vehodaat atzmo ninhu! ella bidrabba kamippalgi – deamar rabba, mippene ma amra tora: mode miktzat hattaana – yishshava? chazaka – en adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo;

Vehay, bechulleh bae lemichpereh leh, vehay dela kafreh – mishshum deen adam meiz panav bifne baal chovo; uvechulleh bae delode leh, vehay dela odi leh – ishtemote hu deka mishtemit leh – savar: ad dehavu li zuze ufarana leh; veamar rachamana: remi shevua illaveh, ki hechi delode leh bechulleh.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov savar: la shena bo vela shena bivno – eno meez, vehilkach lav meshiv aveda hu; verabbanan savri: bo hu deeno meez, aval bivno meez, umiddelo meez – meshiv aveda hu.

a: Mishna yetomin shessamchu etzel baal habbayit, o shemminna lahen avihen appotroppos – chayyayv leasser perotehem.
Appotroppos shemminnahu avi yetomim, yishshava. minnuhu bet din – lo yishshava. abba shaul omer: chilluf haddevarim.
Gemara ureminhu: "attem" – velo shuttafin; "attem" – velo arisin; "attem" – velo appotroppin, velo hattorem et sheeno shello!
Amar rav chisda, la kashya: kan lehaachil, kan lehanniach.

Vehatanya: haappotroppin tormin umeasserin – lehaachil velo lehanniach. umochrin lahen behema, avadim ushefachot, battim, sadot ucheramim – lehaachil, aval lo lehanniach. umochrin lahen perot, yenot, shemanim uselatot – lehaachil aval lo lehanniach.
Veosin lahen lulav vaarava vesukka vetzitzit, vechol davar sheyyesh lo kitzva; leetoye shofar. velokchin lahem sefer tora, tefillin umezuzot, vechol davar sheyyesh lo kitzva; leetoye megilla.
Veen poskin alehem tzedaka, veen podin alehen et hashshevuyin, velo kol davar sheen lo kitzva; leetoye tanchume avelim.
Veen appotroppin rashshain ladun – lachuv velizkot – benichse yetomim. lizkot – ammay la? ella "lachuv al menat lizkot" benichse yetomim.
Veen appotroppin rashshain limkor berachok veligol bekarov; beraa veligol beyafa. may tama? dedilma mishtaddefin.

Veen appotroppin rashshain limkor sadot – velikkach avadim, aval mochrin avadim – velokchin bahen sadot. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af lo limkor avadim velikkach sadot. may tama? dilma la meshappeyayn.
Veen appotroppin rashshain lehotzi avadim lecherut; aval mochrin otan laacherim, vaacherim motziin otan lecherut. rabbi omer: omer ani, af hu – noten deme atzmo veyotze, mippene shehu kemochro lo;
Vetzarich lechashshev immahen baacharona. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: eno tzarich. en osin appotroppin nashim vaavadim uketannim, veim minnan avi yetomin – harshut beyado.

Hahu appotroppos dahava beshivavuteh derabbi meir, dahava ka mezabben arata vezaven avde, vela shavkeh rabbi meir. achvo leh bechelmeh "ani laharos veatta livnot?!" afillu hachi la ashgach, amar: divre chalomot lo maalin velo moridin.

Hanhu be tere deiggari behu satan, dechol be shimshe havo ka minnetzu bahade hadade. ikkela rabbi meir lehatam, akkevinhu telata be shimshe, ad daavad lehu shelama. shameh dekaamar: vavy, deappekeh rabbi meir lehahu gavra mibbeteh.

Hahu appotroppos dahava beshivavuteh derabbi yehoshua ben levi, dahava ka mezabben ara vezaven tore, vela amar leh vela midde; savar la kerabbi yose – detanya, amar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo kariti leishti "ishti" uleshori "shori", ella leishti "beti", uleshori "sadi".

Hanhu yatme dahavo semichi gabbe hahi savta. hava lehu torta, shekala vezabbenta nihalayyhu. ato kerovim lekammeh derav nachman, amaru leh: may avidta dimzabbena? amar lehu: "yetomim shessamchu etzel baal habbayit" tenan.
Veha iyyaykkar! birshuta delokeach iyyaykkar. veha la nekiti deme!
Amar lehu: im ken, hayeynu derav chanilay bar idde amar shemuel – deamar rav chanilay bar idde amar shemuel: nichse yetomin hare hen kehekdesh, vela mikkene ella bechaspa.

Chamreh deravna ukeva yatma – mashchu bearbea arbea, veiyyaykkar vekam beshitta shitta. ato lekammeh derav nachman, amar lehu: hayeynu derav chanilay bar idi – deamar rav chanilay bar idi amar shemuel: nichse yetomin hare hen kehekdesh, vela mikkene ella bechaspa.
Meshuch pere miyyatme; iyyaykkur – hayeynu derav chanilay bar idi. zul – lo yehe koach hedyot chamur mehekdesh.
Immeshichu lehu pere leyatme; iyyaykkar – lo yehe koach hedyot chamur mehekdesh. zul – sevur minna, hayeynu derav chanilay bar idi;
Amar lehu rav shisha bereh derav idi: ha raa hi ledidhu – dezimnin demitztarchi lefere, velekka deyahev lehu ad deyahavi zuze.
Yahavi yatme zuze appere; zul – lo yehe koach hedyot chamur min hekdesh. iyyaykkar – sevur minna, hayeynu derav chanilay bar idi;
Amar lehu rav shisha bereh derav idi: ha raa hi ledidhu –
b: Deatu lememar lehu: nisrefu chittechem baaliyyay.
Yahavi lehu zuze leyatme appere; iyyaykkar – lo yehe koach hedyot chamur mehekdesh. zul – sevur minna, hayeynu derav chanilay bar idi;
Amar lehu rav shisha bereh derav idi: ha raa hu ledidhu – dezimnin demitztarchi lezuze, velekka deyahev lehu ad deyahavi lehu pere.
Amar rav ashe: ana verav kahana chatminan ashshetara deimmeh dizera yatma, dimzabbena ara lichraga bela achrazta; deamri nehardae: lichraga velimzone velikvura – mezabbeninan bela achrazta.
Amram tzabbaa appotroppa deyatme hava, ato kerovim lekammeh derav nachman, amri leh: ka lavesh umikkasse miyyatme! amar lehu: ki hechi delishtaman milleh.

Kaachel veshate middidhu, vela amid! emor metzia ashkach. veha ka mafsed! amar lehu: ayyto li sahadi demafsed, veesallekinneh; deamar rav huna chavrin mishshemeh derav: appotroppos demafsed, mesallekinan leh. deittemar: appotroppa demafsed, rav huna amar rav: mesallekinan leh; deve rabbi shela amri: la mesallekinan leh. vehilcheta: mesallekinan leh.
Appotroppos shemminnahu avi yetomim – yishshava: may tama? i lav deit leh hanaa minneh – la hava leh appotroppos; umishshum shevua la ate leimmenoe.
Minnuhu bet din – lo yishshava: milleta bealma hu deaved leve dina; vei ramet aleh shevua ate leimmenoe.
Abba shaul omer: chilluf haddevarim: may tama minnuhu bet din – yishshava? behahi hanaa deka nafek aleh kala deinish mehemna hu – deha samech aleh be dina – mishshum shevua la ate leimmenoe.
Minnahu avi yetomim, lo yishshava – milleta bealma hu deavdi lahadade, vei ramet aleh shevua – ate leimmenoe. amar rav chanan bar amme amar shemuel: hilcheta keabba shaul.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: ze vaze yishshava, vahalacha kidvarav.

Tane rav tachlifa bar mareva kammeh derabbi avahu: appotroppos shemminnahu avi yetomim – yishshava, mippene shehu nose sachar. amar leh: at ayytet kabba vechayylat leh? ella ema: mippene shehu kenose sachar.
Mishna hametamme, vehamedammea, vehamenassech; beshogeg – patur, bemezid – chayyayv.
Gemara ittemar: "menassech" – rav amar: menassech mammash, ushemuel amar: mearev.
Man deamar mearev, may tama la amar menassech? amar lach: menassech – kam leh bidrabba minneh.
Veiddach, kidrabbi yirmeya – deamar rabbi yirmeya: mishsheat hagebaha hu dikna; mitchayyev benafsho la have ad sheat nissuch.
Uleman deamar menassech, may tama la amar mearev? amar lach: mearev
